pob.text: And after all this[a], Yahweh struck him in his intestines with an incurable disease.

spob.text: After all this, Yahweh struck him with a disease of the intestines that could not be cured.

public_domain_references.bsb: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
public_domain_references.web: After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
public_domain_references.asv: And after all this Jehovah smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
public_domain_references.brenton: And after all these things the Lord smote him in the bowels with an incurable disease.

pob.text: And after some time[a], at the end of two years, his bowels came out because of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases[b]. And his people made no burning for him like the burning for his fathers.

spob.text: His sickness lasted two years. At the end of that time, his internal organs[a] came out of his body because of the sickness, and he died from severe diseases. His people did not honor him with the funeral burning[b] they had held for his ancestors.

public_domain_references.bsb: This continued day after day until two full years had passed. Finally, his intestines came out because of his disease, and he died in severe pain. And his people did not make a fire in his honor as they had done for his fathers.
public_domain_references.web: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
public_domain_references.asv: And it came to pass, in process of time, at the end of two years, that his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it continued from day to day: and when the time of the days came [to] two years, his bowels fell out with the disease, and he died by a grievous distemper: and his people performed no funeral, like the funeral of his fathers.

pob.text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign[a], and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. Then he departed with no regret, and they buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

spob.text: He became king at age thirty-two and ruled in Jerusalem for eight years. When he passed away, he was not mourned.[a] They buried him in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

public_domain_references.bsb: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He died, to no one’s regret, and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
public_domain_references.web: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.
public_domain_references.asv: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years: and he departed without being desired; and they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
public_domain_references.brenton: He was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. And he departed without honour, and was buried in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

pob.text: Then the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah[a], his youngest son, king in his place, because the raiding band that came with the Arabs into the camp had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram, king of Judah, became king.

spob.text: The people of Jerusalem made Jehoram’s youngest son, Ahaziah, king in his place. They did this because the raiding band that entered the camp with the Arabs[a] had killed all of Jehoram’s older sons. So Ahaziah, son of King Jehoram of Judah, became king.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, the youngest son of Jehoram, king in his place, since the raiders who had come into the camp with the Arabs had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah.
public_domain_references.web: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
public_domain_references.asv: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead; for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ochozias his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of robbers that came against them, even the Arabians and the Alimazonians, had slain all the elder ones. So Ochozias son of Joram king of Juda reigned.

pob.text: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he became king[a], and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah[b], the daughter of Omri.

spob.text: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he became king.[a] He ruled in Jerusalem for one year. His mother was Athaliah,[b] the daughter of Omri.

public_domain_references.brenton: Ochozias began to reign when he was twenty years old, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Gotholia, the daughter of Ambri.

pob.text: He too walked in the ways of the house of Ahab[a], because his mother was his counselor to act wickedly.

spob.text: He too followed the ways of Ahab’s family, because his mother advised him to act wickedly.

public_domain_references.bsb: Ahaziah also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor in wickedness.
public_domain_references.web: He also walked in the ways of Ahab’s house, because his mother was his counselor in acting wickedly.
public_domain_references.asv: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab; for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
public_domain_references.kjv: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he walked in the way of the house of Achaab; for his mother was his counsellor to do evil.

pob.text: He did what was evil in the sight of Yahweh[a], like the house of Ahab, because they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.

spob.text: He did what was evil in Yahweh’s sight, just as Ahab’s family had done. After his father died, members of that family were his advisers, and their advice led to his destruction.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for to his destruction they were his counselors after the death of his father.
public_domain_references.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
public_domain_references.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, as did the house of Ahab; for they were his counsellors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord as the house of Achaab [had done]: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

pob.text: He also walked by their counsel[a], and he went with Jehoram son of Ahab, king of Israel, to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead[c][b]; and the Arameans wounded Joram.

spob.text: He also followed their advice. He went with Jehoram son of Ahab, the king of Israel, to fight King Hazael of Aram at Ramoth-gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram.[a]

public_domain_references.web: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
public_domain_references.asv: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians wounded Joram.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he walked in their counsels, and he went with Joram son of Achaab king of Israel to war against Azael king of Syria to Ramoth Galaad: and the archers smote Joram.

pob.text: So he returned to Jezreel to recover[a], because of the wounds that they had inflicted on him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. And Azariah son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram son of Ahab in Jezreel[b], because he was sick.

spob.text: So Jehoram returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds he had received at Ramah while fighting Hazael king of Aram. Azariah son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to visit Jehoram son of Ahab in Jezreel because he was sick.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: so he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab, because Joram had been wounded.
public_domain_references.web: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
public_domain_references.asv: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Joram returned to Jezrael to be healed of the wounds wherewith the Syrians smote him in Ramoth, when he fought against Azael king of Syria. And Ochozias son of Joram, king of Juda, went down to see Joram the son of Achaab at Jezrael because he was sick.

pob.text: Ahaziah’s downfall[a], by his going to Joram, was from God; and when he came, he went out with Jehoram to Jehu son of Nimshi, whom Yahweh had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

spob.text: Ahaziah’s visit to Joram became the occasion for his downfall, which was from God. When he arrived, he went out with Jehoram toward Jehu son of Nimshi.[a] Yahweh had anointed Jehu to cut off Ahab’s family.

public_domain_references.bsb: Ahaziah’s downfall came from God when he went to visit Joram. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.
public_domain_references.web: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Yahweh had anointed to cut off Ahab’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went unto Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Jehovah had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
public_domain_references.brenton: And destruction from God came upon Ochozias in [his] coming to Joram; for when he had come, Joram went out with him against Jeu the son of Namessei, the anointed of the Lord against the house of Achaab.

pob.text: And it happened[a], when Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, that he found the officials of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers, serving Ahaziah[b], and he killed them.

spob.text: While Jehu was carrying out judgment against Ahab’s royal house,[a] he found Judah’s officials and Ahaziah’s nephews,[b] who were serving Ahaziah. He killed them.

public_domain_references.bsb: So while Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the rulers of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers who were serving Ahaziah, and he killed them.
public_domain_references.web: When Jehu was executing judgment on Ahab’s house, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and killed them.
public_domain_references.asv: And it came to pass, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, that he found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, ministering to Ahaziah, and slew them.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass, when Jeu was taking vengeance on the house of Achaab, that he found the princes of Juda and the brethren of Ochozias ministering to Ochozias, and he slew them.

pob.text: And he sought Ahaziah[a], and they captured him while he was hiding in Samaria, and they brought him to Jehu and put him to death. Then they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat[b], who sought Yahweh with all his heart.” And the house of Ahaziah had no power to retain the kingdom.

spob.text: Jehu searched for Ahaziah. His men found him hiding in Samaria, captured him, and brought him to Jehu. They put him to death. Then they buried him because they said, “He is a descendant of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahweh with all his heart.” Ahaziah’s royal family could not hold on to the kingdom.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Jehu looked for Ahaziah, and Jehu’s soldiers captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. So Ahaziah was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, “He is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.” So no one was left from the house of Ahaziah with the strength to rule the kingdom.
public_domain_references.web: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahweh with all his heart.” The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.
public_domain_references.asv: And he sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu, and slew him; and they buried him, for they said, He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Jehovah with all his heart. And the house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he [is] the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So there was none in the house of Ochozias to secure their power in the kingdom.

pob.text: Athaliah[a], the mother of Ahaziah, saw that her son was dead, and she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

spob.text: Athaliah,[a] Ahaziah’s mother, saw that her son was dead. She took action and destroyed all the descendants in Judah’s royal line.

public_domain_references.bsb: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to annihilate all the royal heirs of the house of Judah.
public_domain_references.web: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.
public_domain_references.asv: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gotholia the mother of Ochozias saw that her son was dead, and she arose and destroyed all the seed royal in the house of Juda.

pob.text: But Jehoshabeath[a], the king’s daughter, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were being put to death, and she put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, hid him from Athaliah[c][b], and she did not put him to death.

spob.text: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash son of Ahaziah and secretly stole him away from the other royal sons who were being put to death.[a] She placed Joash and his nurse in a bedroom and hid him from Athaliah. Jehoshabeath was King Jehoram’s daughter, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, and Ahaziah’s sister. As a result, Athaliah did not kill Joash.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: But Jehoshabeath daughter of King Jehoram took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being murdered, and she put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram and the wife of Jehoiada the priest, was Ahaziah’s sister, she hid Joash from Athaliah so that she could not kill him.
public_domain_references.web: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. public_domain_references.asv: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
public_domain_references.kjv: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
public_domain_references.brenton: But Josabeeth, the daughter of the king, took Joas the son of Ochozias and rescued him secretly out of the midst of the sons of the king that were put to death, and she placed him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Josabeeth daughter of king Joram, sister of Ochozias, wife of Jodae the priest, hid him, and she [even] hid him from Gotholia, and she did not slay him.

pob.text: And he was with them in the house of God[a], hiding himself for six years[b], while Athaliah was reigning over the land.

spob.text: He stayed with them in God’s temple,[a] where he hid for six years.[b] During those years, Athaliah ruled the land.

public_domain_references.bsb: And Joash remained hidden with them in the house of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
public_domain_references.web: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
public_domain_references.asv: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he was with him hid in the house of God six years; and Gotholia reigned over the land.

pob.text: In the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself and took the commanders of hundreds into covenant with him: Azariah son of Jeroham[a], Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.

spob.text: In the seventh year, Jehoiada gathered his courage and made a covenant with these commanders over units of one hundred: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself and made a covenant with the commanders of hundreds—with Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
public_domain_references.web: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.
public_domain_references.asv: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
public_domain_references.kjv: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And in the eighth year Jodae strengthened [himself], and took the captains of hundreds, Azarias the son of Joram, and Ismael the son of Joanan, and Azarias the son of Obed, and Maasæas the son of Adia, and Elisaphan the son of Zacharias, with him into the house of the Lord.

pob.text: And they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah[a], and the heads of the fathers’ houses of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

spob.text: They traveled throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from every city in Judah, along with the leaders of Israel’s ancestral family groups. Then they came to Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.bsb: So they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah and the heads of the families of Israel. And when they came to Jerusalem,
public_domain_references.web: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ [houses] of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they went round about Juda, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Juda, and heads of the families of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

pob.text: And all the assembly made a covenant in the house of God with the king, and he said to them, “Look, the king’s son will reign, just as the LORD spoke concerning the sons of David.”

spob.text: The whole assembly made a covenant with the king at God’s temple. Then Jehoiada[a] said to them, “Look! The king’s son will reign, just as the LORD said about David’s descendants.”

public_domain_references.bsb: the whole assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of God. “Behold, the king’s son!” said Jehoiada. “He must reign, just as the LORD promised concerning the descendants of David.
public_domain_references.web: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the sons of David.
public_domain_references.asv: And all the assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as Jehovah hath spoken concerning the sons of David.

public_domain_references.asv: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to restore the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And it came to pass after this, [that] Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass afterward that it came into the heart of Joas to repair the house of the Lord.

pob.text: So he gathered the priests and the Levites and said to them[a], “Go out to the cities of Judah and collect silver from all Israel to repair the house of your God year by year[b], and you must act quickly in this matter.” But the Levites did not act quickly.

spob.text: He called the priests and Levites together and told them, “Go to the cities of Judah. Each year, collect silver[a] from all Israel to repair the house of your God.[b] Do this quickly.” But the Levites did not act quickly.

public_domain_references.bsb: So he gathered the priests and Levites and said, “Go out to the cities of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the house of your God. Do it quickly.” The Levites, however, did not make haste.
public_domain_references.web: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.
public_domain_references.asv: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year; and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened [it] not.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he gathered the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out into the cities of Juda, and collect money of all Israel to repair the house of the Lord from year to year, and make haste to speak [of it]. But the Levites hasted not.

pob.text: Then the king called Jehoiada the chief and said to him, “Why have you not required the Levites to bring from Judah and from Jerusalem the tax of Moses the servant of the LORD and of the assembly of Israel for the tent of the testimony?”

spob.text: Then the king summoned Jehoiada, the chief, and asked him, “Why haven’t you ordered the Levites to collect from Judah and Jerusalem the tax that Moses, the servant of the LORD, required from the assembly of Israel for the Tent of the Testimony?”

public_domain_references.bsb: So the king called Jehoiada the high priest and said, “Why have you not required the Levites to bring from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the LORD and by the assembly of Israel for the Tent of the Testimony?”
public_domain_references.web: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of Yahweh, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”
public_domain_references.asv: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the tax of Moses the servant of Jehovah, and of the assembly of Israel, for the tent of the testimony?
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, [according to the commandment] of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
public_domain_references.brenton: And king Joas called Jodae the chief, and said to him, Why hast thou not looked after the Levites, so that they should bring from Juda and Jerusalem that which was prescribed by Moses the man of God, when he assembled Israel at the tabernacle of witness?

pob.text: For Athaliah[a], that wicked woman, and her sons had broken into the house of God and had also made all the holy things of the house of Yahweh for the Baals.

spob.text: For the sons of Athaliah—the wicked woman—had broken into God’s temple. They had also used all the sacred objects from Yahweh’s temple in worship of the Baals.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: For the sons of that wicked woman Athaliah had broken into the house of God and had even used the sacred objects of the house of the LORD for the Baals.
public_domain_references.web: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of Yahweh’s house to the Baals.
public_domain_references.asv: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of Jehovah did they bestow upon the Baalim.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.
public_domain_references.brenton: For Gotholia was a transgressor, and her sons tore down the house of God; for they offered the holy things of the house of the Lord to Baalim.

pob.text: Then the king commanded[a], and they made one chest and placed it outside at the gate of the house of Yahweh.

spob.text: Then the king gave the order. They made one chest[a] and placed it outside at the gate of Yahweh’s house.

public_domain_references.bsb: At the king’s command a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of Yahweh’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And at the king’s commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king said, Let a box be made, and let it be put at the gate of the house of the Lord without.

pob.text: And they made a proclamation in Judah and Jerusalem to bring to Yahweh the levy of Moses the servant of God for Israel in the wilderness[a].

spob.text: Throughout Judah and Jerusalem, they announced that the people must bring to Yahweh the required contribution Moses, the servant of God, had required from Israel in the wilderness.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And a proclamation was issued in Judah and Jerusalem that they were to bring to the LORD the tax imposed by Moses the servant of God on Israel in the wilderness.
public_domain_references.web: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for Yahweh the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.
public_domain_references.asv: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for Jehovah the tax that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection [that] Moses the servant of God [laid] upon Israel in the wilderness.
public_domain_references.brenton: And let [men] proclaim in Juda and in Jerusalem, that [the people] should bring to the Lord, as Moses the servant of God spoke concerning Israel in the wilderness.

pob.text: Then all the officials and all the people rejoiced[a], and they brought their contributions and threw them into the chest until it was full.

spob.text: Then the officials and the people all rejoiced. They brought their contributions and threw them into the chest until it was full.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: All the officers and all the people rejoiced and brought their contributions, and they dropped them in the chest until it was full.
public_domain_references.web: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it.
public_domain_references.asv: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
public_domain_references.kjv: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
public_domain_references.brenton: And all the princes and all the people gave, and brought in, and cast into the box until it was filled.

pob.text: And whenever the chest was brought by the Levites to the king’s oversight[a], and when they saw that the money was abundant, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer would come and empty the chest, then carry it and return it to its place. Thus they did day by day[b], and they gathered money in abundance.

spob.text: Whenever the Levites brought the collection chest to be handled under the king’s supervision, and it contained a large amount of money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied it. Then they carried the chest back to its place. They did this day after day and collected a great deal of money.

public_domain_references.bsb: Whenever the chest was brought by the Levites to the king’s overseers and they saw that there was a large amount of money, the royal scribe and the officer of the high priest would come and empty the chest and carry it back to its place. They did this daily and gathered the money in abundance.
public_domain_references.web: Whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
public_domain_references.asv: And it was so, that, at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that [there was] much money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass, when they brought in the box to the officers of the king by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that the money was more than sufficient, then came the king's scribe, and the officer of the high priest, and emptied the box, and restored it to its place. Thus they did day by day, and collected much money.

pob.text: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to those doing the work of the service of the house of Yahweh[a], and they hired stonecutters and craftsmen to restore the house of Yahweh[c][b], and also craftsmen in iron and bronze to strengthen the house of Yahweh.

spob.text: The king and Jehoiada gave the money to those carrying out the work on Yahweh’s house, the temple. They hired stonecutters and other skilled workers to restore the temple, along with workers in iron and bronze to strengthen it.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the king and Jehoiada would give the money to those who supervised the labor on the house of the LORD to hire stonecutters and carpenters to restore the house of the LORD, as well as workers in iron and bronze to repair the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of Yahweh’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore Yahweh’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair Yahweh’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of Jehovah; and they hired masons and carpenters to restore the house of Jehovah, and also such as wrought iron and brass to repair the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king and Jodae the priest gave it to the workmen employed in the service of the house of the Lord, and they hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, also smiths and braziers to repair the house of the Lord.

pob.text: So the workmen labored[a], and the repair work progressed by their hand[b]; they restored the house of God to its proper condition and strengthened it.

spob.text: The workers continued their work, and the repairs moved forward through their efforts. They restored God’s temple to its proper condition and made it strong.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the workmen labored, and in their hands the repair work progressed. They restored the house of God according to its specifications, and they reinforced it.
public_domain_references.web: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.
public_domain_references.asv: So the workmen wrought, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands, and they set up the house of God in its state, and strengthened it.
public_domain_references.kjv: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the workmen wrought, and the works prospered in their hands, and they established the house of the Lord on its foundation, and strengthened [it].

pob.text: When they had finished[a], they brought the rest of the silver before the king and Jehoiada, and with it he made articles for the house of Yahweh, articles for ministry and for offering up, and bowls, and articles of gold and silver[c][b]. And they were offering burnt offerings in the house of Yahweh continually all the days of Jehoiada.

spob.text: When they had finished, they brought the remaining silver to the king and Jehoiada. It was used to make equipment for Yahweh’s temple: items used in temple ministry and for presenting offerings,[a] along with bowls and other articles of gold and silver. Throughout Jehoiada’s lifetime, they continued to offer burnt offerings regularly in Yahweh’s temple.

public_domain_references.bsb: When they were finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada to make with it the articles for the house of the LORD—utensils for the service and for the burnt offerings, dishes, and other objects of gold and silver. Throughout the days of Jehoiada, burnt offerings were presented regularly in the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for Yahweh’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in Yahweh’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.
public_domain_references.asv: And when they had made an end, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of Jehovah, even vessels wherewith to minister and to offer, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt-offerings in the house of Jehovah continually all the days of Jehoiada.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when they had finished [it], they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD, [even] vessels to minister, and to offer [withal], and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.
public_domain_references.brenton: And when they had finished [it], they brought to the king and to Jodae the remainder of the money, and they made vessels for the house of the Lord, vessels of service for whole-burnt-offerings, and gold and silver [censers]: and they offered up whole-burnt-offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jodae.

pob.text: And Jehoiada grew old and was full of days[a], and he died. He was one hundred and thirty years old at his death.

spob.text: Jehoiada grew old and lived a full lifetime. Then he died at the age of 130.

public_domain_references.bsb: When Jehoiada was old and full of years, he died at the age of 130.
public_domain_references.web: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.
public_domain_references.asv: But Jehoiada waxed old and was full of days, and he died; a hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old [was he] when he died.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Jodae grew old, being full of days, and he died, being a hundred and thirty years old at his death.

pob.text: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings[a], because he had done good in Israel[b], and toward God and his house.

spob.text: They buried him in the city of David among the kings. They honored him this way because of the good he had done in Israel for God and for God’s house, the temple.

public_domain_references.bsb: And Jehoiada was buried with the kings in the City of David, because he had done what was good in Israel for God and His temple.
public_domain_references.web: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.
public_domain_references.asv: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they buried him with the kings in the city of David, because he had dealt well with Israel, and with God and his house.

pob.text: After the death of Jehoiada[a], the officials of Judah came and bowed down to the king[b]. Then the king listened to them.

spob.text: After Jehoiada died, the officials of Judah came and bowed before the king. Then the king listened to them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: After the death of Jehoiada, however, the officials of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and he listened to them.
public_domain_references.web: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.
public_domain_references.asv: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass after the death of Jodae, [that] the princes of Juda went in, and did obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened to them.

pob.text: And they abandoned the house of Yahweh[a], the God of their fathers, and served the Asherim and the idols. So wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem because of this guilt of theirs.

spob.text: They abandoned the temple of Yahweh, the God of their ancestors, and worshiped the Asherim[a] and the idols. Because they were guilty of this, wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.bsb: They abandoned the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and idols. So wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this guilt of theirs.
public_domain_references.web: They abandoned the house of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.
public_domain_references.asv: And they forsook the house of Jehovah, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherim and the idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they forsook the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served the Astartes and idols: and there was wrath upon Juda and Jerusalem in that day.

pob.text: Yet he sent prophets among them to bring them back to Yahweh[a], and they testified against them, but they would not listen.

spob.text: Yet he sent prophets among the people to bring them back to Yahweh. The prophets gave solemn testimony against them,[a] but the people refused to listen.

public_domain_references.bsb: Nevertheless, the LORD sent prophets to bring the people back to Him and to testify against them; but they would not listen.
public_domain_references.web: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to Yahweh, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.
public_domain_references.asv: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto Jehovah; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
public_domain_references.brenton: Yet he sent prophets to them, to turn them to the Lord; but they hearkened not: and he testified to them, but they obeyed not.

pob.text: And the Spirit of God clothed Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest[a], and he stood above the people and said to them, “Thus says God: Why are you transgressing the commandments of Yahweh, so that you do not prosper? Because you have forsaken Yahweh[b], he has also forsaken you.”

spob.text: Then the Spirit of God clothed Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada the priest, with power.[a] Zechariah stood above the people and said, “This is what God says: ‘Why are you breaking Yahweh’s commandments? Because of this, you will not prosper. You have abandoned Yahweh, so he has also abandoned you.’”

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood up before the people and said to them, “This is what God says: ‘Why do you transgress the commandments of the LORD so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, He has forsaken you.’”
public_domain_references.web: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey Yahweh’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken Yahweh, he has also forsaken you.’”
public_domain_references.asv: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of Jehovah, so that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken Jehovah, he hath also forsaken you.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Spirit of God came upon Azarias the son of Jodae the priest, and he stood up above the people, and said, Thus saith the Lord, Why do ye transgress the commandments of the Lord? so shall ye not prosper; for ye have forsaken the Lord, and he will forsake you.

pob.text: So they conspired against him and stoned him at the command of the king[c][b][a], in the court of the house of Yahweh.

spob.text: They plotted together against him. Then, on the king’s orders, they stoned him to death in the courtyard of Yahweh’s house.

public_domain_references.bsb: But they conspired against Zechariah, and by order of the king, they stoned him in the courtyard of the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they conspired against him, and stoned him by command of king Joas in the court of the Lord's house.

pob.text: But King Joash did not remember the kindness that Jehoiada his father had shown him[a], and he killed his son. As he was dying, he said[c][b], “May Yahweh see and require it.”

spob.text: Yet King Joash did not remember the kindness Jehoiada had shown him, though Jehoiada had been like a father to him. Joash killed Jehoiada’s son. As the son was dying, he said, “May Yahweh see this and call Joash to account.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Thus King Joash failed to remember the kindness that Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had extended to him. Instead, Joash killed Jehoiada’s son. As he lay dying, Zechariah said, “May the LORD see this and call you to account.”
public_domain_references.web: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May Yahweh look at it, and repay it.”
public_domain_references.asv: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, Jehovah look upon it, and require it.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon [it], and require [it].
public_domain_references.brenton: So Joas remembered not the kindness which his father Jodae had exercised towards him, but slew his son. And as he died, he said, The Lord look upon [it], and judge.

pob.text: At the turn of the year[a], the army of Aram came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the leaders of the people from among the people[c][b], and sent all their spoil to the king of Damascus.

spob.text: At the turn of the year,[a] the army of Aram[b] marched against him. They entered Judah and Jerusalem, killed all the leaders of the people from among the people, and sent all the plunder they had taken to the king of Damascus.

public_domain_references.bsb: In the spring, the army of Aram went to war against Joash. They entered Judah and Jerusalem and destroyed all the leaders of the people, and they sent all the plunder to their king in Damascus.
public_domain_references.web: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.
public_domain_references.asv: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the army of the Syrians came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And it came to pass at the end of the year, [that] the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass after the end of the year, [that] the host of Syria went up against him, and came against Juda and Jerusalem: and they slew all the chiefs of the people among the people, and all their spoils they sent to the king of Damascus.

pob.text: For the army of Aram came with few men[a], but Yahweh gave a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers[c][b]. Thus they executed judgment on Joash.

spob.text: The army of Aram came with only a few men. Yet Yahweh gave the very large army of Judah into their power, because the people of Judah had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers. So the Arameans carried out judgment on Joash.

public_domain_references.bsb: Although the Aramean army had come with only a few men, the LORD delivered into their hand a very great army. Because Judah had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, judgment was executed on Joash.
public_domain_references.web: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and Yahweh delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.
public_domain_references.asv: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and Jehovah delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken Jehovah, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment upon Joash.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
public_domain_references.brenton: For the army of Syria came with few men, yet God gave into their hands a very large army, because they had forsaken the God of their fathers; and he brought judgments on Joas.

pob.text: When they departed from him—for they left him with many diseases—his servants conspired against him because of the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest[a], and they killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the tombs of the kings.

spob.text: After the Arameans left Joash, leaving him suffering from many illnesses, his servants plotted against him because of the blood that had been shed—the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest.[a] They killed Joash in his bed, and he died. He was buried in the city of David, but not in the royal tombs.

public_domain_references.bsb: And when the Arameans had withdrawn, they left Joash severely wounded. His own servants conspired against him for shedding the blood of the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him on his bed. So he died and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
public_domain_references.web: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. pob.text: And these were the men who conspired against him: Zabad son of Shimeath the Ammonite woman[a], and Jehozabad son of Shimrith the Moabite woman.

spob.text: The men who plotted together against him were Zabad and Jehozabad. Zabad was the son of Shimeath, an Ammonite woman, and Jehozabad was the son of Shimrith, a Moabite woman.

pob.text: His sons[a], the many oracles against him, and the founding of the house of God—behold, they are written in the Midrash of the Book of the Kings[b]. And Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

public_domain_references.brenton: And all his sons, and the five came to him: and the other [matters], behold, they are written in the book of the kings. And Amasias his son reigned in his stead.

pob.text: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king[a], and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan[b], from Jerusalem.

spob.text: Amaziah became king at the age of twenty-five. He ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother, Jehoaddan, was from Jerusalem.

pob.text: He did what was right in the eyes of Yahweh[a], yet not with a whole heart.

public_domain_references.brenton: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a perfect heart.

pob.text: When the kingdom was firmly in his hand[a], he killed his servants who had struck down the king his father.

spob.text: When his rule over the kingdom was secure, he killed the servants who had killed his father, the king.

pob.text: But he did not put their sons to death[a], because it is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where Yahweh commanded, saying, “Fathers shall not be put to death for sons, and sons shall not be put to death for fathers, but each man shall die for his own sin.”

spob.text: But he did not put their sons to death. He did this because the Law in the Book of Moses records Yahweh’s command: “Fathers must not be put to death for what their sons have done, and sons must not be put to death for what their fathers have done. Each man is to be put to death only for his own sin.”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Yet he did not put their sons to death, but acted according to what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the LORD commanded: “Fathers must not be put to death for their children, and children must not be put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.”
public_domain_references.web: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”
public_domain_references.asv: But he put not their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as Jehovah commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.
public_domain_references.kjv: But he slew not their children, but [did] as [it is] written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
public_domain_references.brenton: But he slew not their sons, according to the covenant of the law of the Lord, as it is written, [and] as the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, and the sons shall not die for the fathers, but they shall die each for his own sin.

pob.text: Then Amaziah gathered Judah and appointed them by fathers’ houses under commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds[a], for all Judah and Benjamin. He mustered them from twenty years old and upward, and found them to be three hundred thousand choice men, going out to war[c][b], able to handle spear and shield.

spob.text: Then Amaziah gathered the men of Judah. He organized the men from all Judah and Benjamin by their ancestral family groups, placing them under commanders of groups of a thousand and a hundred. He counted those who were twenty years old or older and found 300,000 able-bodied men[a] fit for military service and able to use spears and shields.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Amaziah gathered the people of Judah and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and of hundreds. And he numbered those twenty years of age or older throughout Judah and Benjamin and found 300,000 chosen men able to serve in the army, bearing the spear and shield.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and ordered them according to their fathers’ houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. pob.text: And he hired from Israel one hundred thousand mighty men of valor for one hundred talents of silver[a].

spob.text: He hired 100,000 capable soldiers from Israel, paying them 100 talents of silver.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: He also hired 100,000 mighty warriors from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

pob.text: But a man of God came to him[a], saying, “O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for Yahweh is not with Israel, with all the sons of Ephraim.”

spob.text: But a man of God came to him and said, “Your Majesty, do not take Israel’s army with you, because Yahweh is not with Israel—that is, with the people of Ephraim.”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: But a man of God came to him and said, “O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel—not with any of the Ephraimites.

pob.text: But if you do go[a], act resolutely in battle; God will make you stumble before the enemy[b], for there is power in God to help and to make stumble.

spob.text: But if you do go, fight with determination. God will make you stumble before the enemy,[a] because God has power both to help and to bring down.

public_domain_references.bsb: Even if you go and fight bravely in battle, God will make you stumble before the enemy, for God has power to help and power to overthrow.”
public_domain_references.web: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”
public_domain_references.asv: But if thou wilt go, do [valiantly], be strong for the battle: God will cast thee down before the enemy; for God hath power to help, and to cast down.
public_domain_references.kjv: But if thou wilt go, do [it], be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

pob.text: Amaziah said to the man of God[a], “But what should be done about the hundred talents that I have given to the troops of Israel?” The man of God said[b], “Yahweh is able to give you much more than this.”

spob.text:
Amaziah asked the man of God, “But what about the large sum of silver I gave to the Israelite troops?”[a]

The man of God answered, “Yahweh can give you much more than that.”

pob.text: So Amaziah separated them[a], the troops that had come to him from Ephraim, to go to their place. And they became very angry with Judah and returned to their place in fierce anger.

spob.text: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. They became very angry with Judah and returned home in fierce anger.

pob.text: Then Amaziah strengthened himself[a], led his people, and went to the Valley of Salt, where he struck down ten thousand of the sons of Seir.

spob.text: Then Amaziah gathered his strength and led his people to the Valley of Salt. There he struck down ten thousand people of Seir.[a]

pob.text: And the sons of Judah captured ten thousand alive[a], brought them to the top of the cliff, and threw them down from the top of the cliff[b], and all of them were dashed to pieces.

pob.text: But the men of the troop whom Amaziah had sent back from going with him to battle raided the cities of Judah[a], from Samaria to Beth-horon[b], and struck down three thousand of them and took much plunder.

spob.text: But the soldiers whom Amaziah had sent back so they would not go with him into battle raided cities in Judah from Samaria to Beth-horon. They struck down three thousand people and carried off a great amount of plunder.

pob.text: It happened[a], after Amaziah came from striking down the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the sons of Seir and set them up for himself as gods; and before them he bowed down[c][b], and to them he burned incense.

spob.text: After Amaziah came back from striking down the Edomites, he brought with him the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down before them, and burned incense to them.

pob.text: Then Yahweh’s anger burned against Amaziah[a], and he sent a prophet to him, who said to him, “Why have you sought the gods of the people who did not deliver their people from your hand?”

spob.text: Then Yahweh’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent a prophet to him. The prophet said, “Why have you turned to that people’s gods?[a] They did not save their own people from your grasp.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet, who said, “Why have you sought this people’s gods, which could not deliver them from your hand?”
public_domain_references.web: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, who said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of thy hand?
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
public_domain_references.brenton: And the anger of the Lord came upon Amasias, and he sent him a prophet, and he said to him, Why hast thou sought the gods of the people, which have not rescued their own people out of thine hand?

pob.text: And it happened[a], as he was speaking to him, that the king said to him, “Have we made you the king’s adviser? Stop! Why should they strike you down?” So the prophet stopped and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you[c][b], because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

spob.text: While the prophet was speaking to him, the king said, “Did we appoint you as the king’s adviser? Stop! Why should they[a] strike you down?” So the prophet stopped and said, “I know that God has decided to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my advice.”

public_domain_references.bsb: While he was still speaking, the king asked, “Have we made you the counselor to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?” So the prophet stopped, but he said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not heeded my advice.”

Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass when the prophet was speaking to him, that he said to him, Have I made thee king's counsellor? take heed lest thou be scourged: and the prophet forebore, and said, I know that [God] is disposed against thee to destroy thee, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not hearkened to my counsel.

pob.text: Then Amaziah king of Judah took counsel and sent to Joash son of Jehoahaz[a], son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let us face one another.”

spob.text: After seeking advice, Amaziah king of Judah sent word to Joash king of Israel, the son of Jehoahaz and grandson of Jehu. Amaziah said, “Come, let us face each other.”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Amaziah king of Judah took counsel and sent word to the king of Israel Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu. “Come, let us meet face to face,” he said.

public_domain_references.asv: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

pob.text: Then Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah[a], saying, “The thornbush that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as a wife.’ Then a wild beast of the field that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thornbush.”

spob.text: Then Joash king of Israel sent this message to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thornbush[a] in Lebanon sent this message to a cedar in Lebanon: ‘Give your daughter to my son as his wife.’ Then a wild animal in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thornbush.”

public_domain_references.bsb: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.

public_domain_references.asv: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trod down the thistle.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that [was] in Lebanon sent to the cedar that [was] in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that [was] in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

pob.text: You said[a], ‘Look, you have struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up to boast.’ Now stay at home. Why should you provoke disaster, so that you fall—you and Judah with you?

spob.text: You said, “Look, you defeated Edom! Your victory has made your heart swell with pride, and you boast.[a]” Now stay home. Why stir up a conflict that will bring disaster, causing you and Judah to fall together?

public_domain_references.bsb: You have said, ‘Look, I have defeated Edom,’ and your heart has become proud and boastful. Now stay at home. Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?”
public_domain_references.web: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?’”
public_domain_references.asv: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten Edom; and thy heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to [thy] hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to [thine] hurt, that thou shouldest fall, [even] thou, and Judah with thee?
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou hast said, Behold, I have smitten Idumea, and thy stout heart exalts thee: now stay at home; for why dost thou implicate thyself in mischief, that thou shouldest fall, and Juda with thee?

pob.text: But Amaziah would not listen[a], for it was from God, in order to give them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought the gods of Edom.

spob.text: But Amaziah refused to listen. This was from God, so that he and his people would be handed over to their enemies, because they had turned to the gods of Edom.

public_domain_references.bsb: But Amaziah would not listen, for this had come from God in order to deliver them into the hand of Jehoash, because they had sought the gods of Edom.
public_domain_references.web: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.
public_domain_references.asv: But Amaziah would not hear; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand [of their enemies], because they had sought after the gods of Edom.
public_domain_references.kjv: But Amaziah would not hear; for it [came] of God, that he might deliver them into the hand [of their enemies], because they sought after the gods of Edom.
public_domain_references.brenton: Nevertheless Amasias hearkened not, for it was of the Lord to deliver him into [the enemy's] hands, because he sought after the gods of the Idumeans.

pob.text: So Joash king of Israel went up[a], and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

spob.text: So King Joash of Israel marched up to Beth-shemesh in Judah. There he and King Amaziah of Judah faced each other.

public_domain_references.bsb: So Jehoash king of Israel advanced, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
public_domain_references.web: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
public_domain_references.asv: So Joash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
public_domain_references.kjv: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, [both] he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which [belongeth] to Judah.
public_domain_references.brenton: So Joas king of Israel went up; and they saw one another, he and Amasias king of Juda, in Bæthsamys, which is of Juda.

pob.text: And Judah was defeated before Israel[a], and each man fled to his tent.

spob.text: Judah was defeated by Israel, and each man fled to his own tent.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And Judah was routed before Israel, and every man fled to his own home.
public_domain_references.web: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.
public_domain_references.asv: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to his tent.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Juda was put to flight before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

pob.text: And Joash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah[a], the son of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem. Then he broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.

spob.text: Joash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah at Beth-shemesh. Amaziah was the son of Joash and the grandson of Jehoahaz. Joash took him to Jerusalem and tore down a section of the city wall about 600 feet (180 meters) long, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: There at Beth-shemesh, Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section of four hundred cubits.
public_domain_references.web: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

pob.text: And he took all the gold and the silver[a], and all the vessels found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages[b], and returned to Samaria.

spob.text: He took all the gold and silver, all the objects found in the house of God under Obed-edom’s care,[a] the treasures from the royal palace, and the hostages.[b] Then he returned to Samaria.

public_domain_references.brenton: And [he took] all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord and with Abdedom, and the treasures of the king's house, and the hostages, and he returned to Samaria.

pob.text: Amaziah son of Joash[a], king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

spob.text: Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, died.

public_domain_references.brenton: And Amasias the [son] of Joas king of Juda lived after the death of Joas the [son] of Joachaz king of Israel fifteen years.

pob.text: The rest of the acts of Amaziah[a], from first to last[b], are they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?

spob.text: Isn’t everything else Amaziah did, from beginning to end, written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?

public_domain_references.brenton: And the rest of the acts of Amasias, the first and the last, lo! are they not written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel?

pob.text: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following Yahweh[a], they conspired against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.

spob.text: From the time Amaziah stopped following Yahweh, they plotted against him in Jerusalem. Amaziah fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him and put him to death there.

public_domain_references.bsb: From the time that Amaziah turned from following the LORD, a conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But men were sent after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.
public_domain_references.web: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following Yahweh, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
public_domain_references.asv: Now from the time that Amaziah did turn away from following Jehovah they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

public_domain_references.brenton: And at the time when Amasias departed from the Lord, then they formed a conspiracy against him; and he fled from Jerusalem to Lachis: and they sent after him to Lachis, and slew him there.

spob.text: They carried his body on horses[a] and buried him with his ancestors in the city of Judah.

public_domain_references.bsb: They carried him back on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.
