pob.text: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah[a], who was sixteen years old[b], and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

spob.text: Then all the people of Judah chose sixteen-year-old Uzziah and made him king as the successor to his father, Amaziah.

public_domain_references.bsb: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
public_domain_references.web: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

pob.text: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah after the king slept with his fathers[a][b].

spob.text: He built Eloth and brought it back under Judah’s control after the king died.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Uzziah was the one who rebuilt Eloth and restored it to Judah after King Amaziah rested with his fathers.

pob.text: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king[a], and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah[b], from Jerusalem.

spob.text: Uzziah became king when he was sixteen years old. He ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-two years. His mother was Jecoliah, who was from Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.bsb: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.web: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.brenton: Ozias began to reign at the age of sixteen years, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jechelia of Jerusalem.

pob.text: He did what was right in the eyes of Yahweh[a], according to all that Amaziah his father had done.

spob.text: He followed the example of his father Amaziah in everything, doing what was right in Yahweh’s eyes.

public_domain_references.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

public_domain_references.brenton: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Amasias his father did.

pob.text: He continued to seek God in the days of Zechariah[a], who had understanding in the visions of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh[b], God made him prosper.

spob.text: He kept seeking God during Zechariah’s lifetime. Zechariah understood visions of God.[a] As long as he sought Yahweh, God gave him success.

public_domain_references.bsb: He sought God throughout the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. And as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success.
public_domain_references.web: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper.

public_domain_references.kjv: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he sought the Lord in the days of Zacharias, who understood the fear of the Lord; and in his days he sought the Lord, and the Lord prospered him.

pob.text: He went out and fought against the Philistines[a], and he broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod[b]; and he built cities in the territory of Ashdod and among the Philistines.

public_domain_references.bsb: Uzziah went out to wage war against the Philistines, and he tore down the walls of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod. Then he built cities near Ashdod and among the Philistines.
public_domain_references.web: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

public_domain_references.kjv: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he went out and fought against the Philistines, and pulled down the walls of Geth, and the walls of Jabner, and the walls of Azotus, and he built cities [near] Azotus, and among the Philistines.

pob.text: God helped him against the Philistines[a], against the Arabians who lived in Gur-baal, and against the Meunites.

spob.text: God helped Uzziah against the Philistines, the Arabian people living in Gur-baal, and the Meunites.[a]

public_domain_references.kjv: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord strengthened him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt on the rock, and against the Minæans.

pob.text: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah[a], and his fame spread as far as the entrance of Egypt[b], for he had become exceedingly strong.

spob.text: The Ammonites paid tribute to Uzziah. His fame reached all the way to the entrance to Egypt,[a] because he had become very powerful.

public_domain_references.bsb: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, for he had become exceedingly powerful.
public_domain_references.web: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.
public_domain_references.asv: And the Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt; for he waxed exceeding strong.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad [even] to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened [himself] exceedingly.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Minæans gave gifts to Ozias; and his fame spread as far as the entering in of Egypt, for he strengthened [himself] exceedingly.

pob.text: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate[a], at the Valley Gate, and at the Angle, and he fortified them.

spob.text: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and where the city wall turned. He fortified the towers.

public_domain_references.bsb: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the angle in the wall, and he fortified them.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

public_domain_references.brenton: And Ozias built towers in Jerusalem, both at the gate of the corner and at the valley gate, and at the corners, and he fortified them.

pob.text: He built towers in the wilderness and cut out many cisterns[a], for he had much livestock; and in the lowland and in the plain he had farmers and vinedressers, in the hills and in the fertile land[c][b], for he loved the soil.

spob.text: He built towers in the wilderness and cut many water-storage pits out of the rock because he had large herds. He had farmers and vineyard workers in the lowland, on the plain, in the hills, and in the fertile countryside[a] because he loved the soil.

public_domain_references.bsb: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns. And since he was a lover of the soil, he had farmers and vinedressers in the hill country and in the fertile fields.

public_domain_references.kjv: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen [also], and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he built towers in the wilderness, and dug many wells, for he had many cattle in the low country and in the plain; and vinedressers in the mountain country and in Carmel: for he was a husbandman.

pob.text: And Uzziah had an army fit for war[a], going out to battle by divisions, according to the number of their enrollment, under the direction of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the authority of Hananiah[b], one of the king’s commanders.

public_domain_references.bsb: Uzziah had an army ready for battle that went out to war by assigned divisions, as recorded by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officers.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
public_domain_references.asv: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, [one] of the king’s captains.

pob.text: Under their command was an army of 307,500[a], making war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

spob.text: They had 307,500 soldiers under their command. These soldiers were trained for war and had great military strength to help the king against the enemy.

public_domain_references.bsb: Under their authority was an army of 307,500 trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.

public_domain_references.asv: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of Jehovah; and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

pob.text: And in every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods[a], and he provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers.

spob.text: In every city throughout Judah, he made worship sites called high places for burning incense to other gods. In this way he provoked Yahweh, the God of his ancestors, to anger.

public_domain_references.bsb: In every city of Judah he built high places to offer incense to other gods, and so he provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers.
public_domain_references.web: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers, to anger.
public_domain_references.asv: And in every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger Jehovah, the God of his fathers.
public_domain_references.kjv: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.
public_domain_references.brenton: and in each several city in Juda he made high places to burn incense to strange gods: and they provoked the Lord God of their fathers.

pob.text: The rest of his acts and all his ways, the first and the last, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

spob.text: The rest of what he did and how he lived, from beginning to end, is recorded in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz and all his ways, from beginning to end, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
public_domain_references.web: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they [are] written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the rest of his acts, and his deeds, the first and the last, behold, [they are] written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

pob.text: And Ahaz lay down with his fathers[a], and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem, for they did not bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

spob.text: Ahaz died. They buried him in the city of Jerusalem because they did not bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel.[a] His son Hezekiah became king in his place.

public_domain_references.bsb: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
public_domain_references.web: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, [even] in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Achaz slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David; for they did not bring him into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Ezekias his son reigned in his stead.

pob.text: Hezekiah became king when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

spob.text: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

public_domain_references.asv: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old; and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Hezekiah began to reign [when he was] five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name [was] Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias began to reign at the age of twenty-five years, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Abia, daughter of Zacharias.

pob.text: He did what was right in the eyes of Yahweh[a], according to all that David his father had done.

spob.text: He did what was right in Yahweh’s eyes. In everything, he followed the example of his father David.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.
public_domain_references.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.
public_domain_references.asv: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that David his father had done.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he did [that which was] right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.

pob.text: In the first year of his reign[a], in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of Yahweh and repaired them.

spob.text: During the first month of the first year of his reign, he opened the doors of Yahweh’s temple and repaired them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: In the first month of the first year of his reign, Hezekiah opened and repaired the doors of the house of the LORD.

public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass, when he was established over his kingdom, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord, and repaired them.

pob.text: Then he brought in the priests and the Levites and assembled them in the eastern square[a].

spob.text: Then he had the priests and Levites come in. He gathered them in the square on the east side.

public_domain_references.web: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,

public_domain_references.brenton: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and put them on the east side,

pob.text: And he said to them[a], “Listen to me, Levites. Now consecrate yourselves, and consecrate the house of Yahweh, the God of your fathers[b], and remove the uncleanness from the holy place.”

spob.text: He said to them, “Levites, listen to me. Now set yourselves apart as holy, and set apart the temple of Yahweh, the God of your fathers, as holy. Remove from the holy place whatever defiles it.[a]”

public_domain_references.bsb: “Listen to me, O Levites,” he said. “Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers. Remove from the Holy Place every impurity.
public_domain_references.web: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of Yahweh, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.
public_domain_references.asv: and said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites; now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of Jehovah, the God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
public_domain_references.kjv: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy [place].
public_domain_references.brenton: and said to them, Hear, ye Levites: now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and cast out the impurity from the holy places.

pob.text: For our fathers acted unfaithfully and did what was evil in the eyes of Yahweh our God[a]. They abandoned him, turned their faces away from the dwelling place of Yahweh[c][b], and turned their backs.

spob.text: Our ancestors were unfaithful and did what Yahweh our God saw as evil. They abandoned him. They turned their faces away from Yahweh’s temple, his dwelling place, and turned their backs in refusal.

public_domain_references.bsb: For our fathers were unfaithful and did evil in the sight of the LORD our God. They abandoned Him, turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the LORD, and turned their backs on Him.
public_domain_references.web: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in Yahweh our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Yahweh, and turned their backs.
public_domain_references.asv: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Jehovah, and turned their backs.
public_domain_references.kjv: For our fathers have trespassed, and done [that which was] evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned [their] backs.
public_domain_references.brenton: For our fathers have revolted, and done that which was evil before the Lord our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their face from the tabernacle of the Lord, and have turned [their] back.

pob.text: They also shut the doors of the vestibule[a], put out the lamps, did not burn incense[b], and did not offer up burnt offerings in the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

spob.text: They also closed the doors of the temple’s entrance hall and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or offer burnt offerings in the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: They also shut the doors of the portico and extinguished the lamps. They did not burn incense or present burnt offerings in the Holy Place of the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.web: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt-offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy [place] unto the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they have shut up the doors of the temple, and put out the lamps, and have not burnt incense, and have not offered whole-burnt-offerings in the holy [place] to the God of Israel.

pob.text: So the wrath of Yahweh came upon Judah and Jerusalem[a], and he made them a horror, a desolation, and an object of hissing[b], as you see with your own eyes.

spob.text: So Yahweh’s wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem. He made them a horrifying sight, left them desolate, and made them a target of scornful hissing, as you can see with your own eyes.

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore, the wrath of the LORD has fallen upon Judah and Jerusalem, and He has made them an object of terror, horror, and mockery, as you can see with your own eyes.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore Yahweh’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore the wrath of Jehovah was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to be tossed to and fro, to be an astonishment, and a hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord was very angry with Juda and Jerusalem, and made them an astonishment, and a desolation, and a hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

pob.text: And behold[a], our fathers have fallen by the sword[b], and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity because of this.

spob.text: Look! Our fathers have fallen to the sword. Our sons, daughters, and wives are captives because of this.

public_domain_references.bsb: For behold, this is why our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and daughters and wives are in captivity.
public_domain_references.web: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
public_domain_references.asv: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
public_domain_references.kjv: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives [are] in captivity for this.
public_domain_references.brenton: And, behold, your fathers have been smitten with the sword, and your sons and your daughters and your wives are in captivity in a land not their own, as it is even now.

pob.text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahweh[a], the God of Israel, so that his burning anger may turn away from us.

spob.text: Now I am determined to make a covenant[a] with Yahweh, the God of Israel, so that his burning anger may turn away from us.

public_domain_references.bsb: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, so that His fierce anger will turn away from us.
public_domain_references.web: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahweh, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
public_domain_references.asv: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Jehovah, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now [it is] in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore it is now in my heart to make a covenant, a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that he may turn away his fierce wrath from us.

pob.text: My sons[a], do not be negligent now, for Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him[d][c][b], and to be his ministers and burners of incense.

spob.text: My sons, do not neglect your duty now. Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him[a] and serve him, to be his ministers and those who burn incense.

public_domain_references.bsb: Now, my sons, do not be negligent, for the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, to minister before Him, and to burn incense.”
public_domain_references.web: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”
public_domain_references.asv: My sons, be not now negligent; for Jehovah hath chosen you to stand before him, to minister unto him, and that ye should be his ministers, and burn incense.
public_domain_references.kjv: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
public_domain_references.brenton: And now be not wanting [to your duty], for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him to minister, and to be ministers and burners of incense to him.

pob.text: Then the Levites arose: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah[a], from the sons of the Kohathites; and from the sons of Merari, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; and from the Gershonites[b], Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah.

spob.text: Then the following Levites stepped forward: from the Kohathite clan, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the clan of Merari, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; and from the Gershonite clan, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah.

pob.text: They gathered their brothers[a], consecrated themselves, and came, according to the command of the king by the words of Yahweh[c][b], to cleanse the house of Yahweh.

spob.text: They gathered their brothers,[a] consecrated themselves for sacred service, and came, as the king commanded and in keeping with Yahweh’s words, to cleanse Yahweh’s house, the temple.

public_domain_references.web: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s words, to cleanse Yahweh’s house.

public_domain_references.brenton: And they gathered their brethren, and they purified themselves according to the king's command by the order of the Lord, to purify the house of the Lord.

pob.text: Then the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD to cleanse it, and they brought out to the court of the house of the LORD all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD. Then the Levites received it to carry it outside to the Kidron Valley.

spob.text: The priests went into the inner part of the LORD’s temple to purify it. They removed everything they found there that made the temple unclean and brought it into the temple courtyard. The Levites took it from there and carried it outside to the Kidron Valley.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the priests went inside the house of the LORD to cleanse it, and they brought out to the courtyard all the unclean things that they found in the temple of the LORD. Then the Levites took these things and carried them out to the Kidron Valley.

public_domain_references.asv: And the priests went in unto the inner part of the house of Jehovah, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of Jehovah into the court of the house of Jehovah. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad to the brook Kidron.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse [it], and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. pob.text: They began to consecrate on the first day of the first month[a], and on the eighth day of the month they came to the vestibule of Yahweh. Then they consecrated the house of Yahweh in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

spob.text: They began preparing Yahweh’s temple for holy use on the first day of the first month. On the eighth day of the month, they reached the front porch of Yahweh’s temple. Then they consecrated Yahweh’s temple over eight days, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.

public_domain_references.bsb: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the LORD. For eight more days they consecrated the house of the LORD itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.
public_domain_references.web: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to Yahweh’s porch. They sanctified Yahweh’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
public_domain_references.asv: Now they began on the first [day] of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of Jehovah; and they sanctified the house of Jehovah in eight days: and on the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now they began on the first [day] of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

pob.text: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and said[a], “We have cleansed all the house of Yahweh, the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the table of the rows and all its utensils.”

spob.text: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported, “We have cleansed the entire temple of Yahweh, the altar for burnt offerings and all its equipment, and the table for bread arranged in rows[a] and all its equipment.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported, “We have cleansed the entire house of the LORD, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table of the showbread with all its utensils.
public_domain_references.web: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace and said, “We have cleansed all Yahweh’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.
public_domain_references.asv: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within [the palace], and said, We have cleansed all the house of Jehovah, and the altar of burnt-offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the table of showbread, with all the vessels thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they went in to king Ezekias, and said, We have purified all the things in the house of the Lord, the altar of whole-burnt-offering, and its vessels, and the table of shew-bread, and its vessels;

pob.text: And all the vessels that King Ahaz cast aside during his reign in his unfaithfulness[a], we have prepared and consecrated; and behold[b], they are before the altar of Yahweh.

spob.text: We have made ready and set apart for holy use all the temple objects that King Ahaz cast aside when he acted unfaithfully during his reign. They are now in front of Yahweh’s altar.

public_domain_references.bsb: Moreover, we have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz in his unfaithfulness cast aside during his reign. They are now in front of the altar of the LORD.”
public_domain_references.web: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before Yahweh’s altar.”
public_domain_references.asv: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away when he trespassed, have we prepared and sanctified; and, behold, they are before the altar of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they [are] before the altar of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: and all the vessels which king Achaz polluted in his reign, in his apostacy, we have prepared and purified: behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.

pob.text: Then King Hezekiah rose early[a], gathered the officials of the city, and went up to the house of Yahweh.

spob.text: Early in the morning, King Hezekiah called the city officials together. Then he went up to Yahweh’s house—the temple.

public_domain_references.bsb: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials and went up to the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to Yahweh’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, and gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And king Ezekias rose early in the morning, and gathered the chief men of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.

pob.text: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he told the sons of Aaron, the priests, to offer them on the altar of Yahweh.

spob.text: They brought seven of each kind of animal: bulls, rams, lambs, and male goats. These animals were a sin offering on behalf of the kingdom, the sanctuary, and Judah. Then he told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to offer the animals on Yahweh’s altar.

public_domain_references.bsb: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And the king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on Yahweh’s altar.
public_domain_references.asv: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he-goats, for a sin-offering for the kingdom and for the sanctuary and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer [them] on the altar of the LORD.

pob.text: Then they slaughtered the cattle[a], and the priests received the blood and splashed it against the altar. They slaughtered the rams and splashed the blood against the altar[b]. They slaughtered the lambs and splashed the blood against the altar.

spob.text: They slaughtered the cattle.[a] The priests collected the blood and splashed it against the altar.[b] Next they slaughtered the rams and splashed their blood against the altar. Then they slaughtered the lambs and splashed their blood against the altar.

public_domain_references.bsb: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They slaughtered the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. And they slaughtered the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
public_domain_references.web: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
public_domain_references.asv: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: and they killed the rams, and sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
public_domain_references.kjv: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled [it] on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they slew the calves, and the priests received the blood, and poured it on the altar: and they slew the rams, and poured the blood upon the altar: also they slew the lambs, and poured the blood round the altar.

pob.text: Then they brought near the goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly[b][a], and they laid their hands on them.

spob.text: Then they brought the goats for the sin offering in front of the king and the gathered people. Hands were then laid on the goats.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then they brought the goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly, who laid their hands on them.
public_domain_references.web: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.
public_domain_references.asv: And they brought near the he-goats for the sin-offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands upon them:
public_domain_references.kjv: And they brought forth the he goats [for] the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
public_domain_references.brenton: And they brought the goats for a sin-offering before the king and the congregation; and laid their hands upon them.

pob.text: The priests slaughtered them and applied their blood to the altar to make atonement for all Israel[b][a], because the king had said that the burnt offering and the sin offering were for all Israel.

spob.text: The priests slaughtered the goats and put their blood on the altar[a] to make atonement for all Israel. They did this because the king had said that the burnt offering and the sin offering[b] were for all Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: And the priests slaughtered the goats and put their blood on the altar for a sin offering, to make atonement for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.
public_domain_references.web: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: and the priests killed them, and they made a sin-offering with their blood upon the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded [that] the burnt-offering and the sin-offering [should be made] for all Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded [that] the burnt offering and the sin offering [should be made] for all Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the priests slew them, and offered their blood as a propitiation on the altar; and they made atonement for all Israel: for the king said, The whole-burnt-offering, and the sin-offerings [are] for all Israel.

pob.text: He stationed the Levites in the house of Yahweh with cymbals[a], harps, and lyres, according to the command of David and of Gad the king’s seer and Nathan the prophet[b], for the command was from Yahweh through his prophets.

spob.text: Hezekiah assigned the Levites their places in Yahweh’s temple, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, in accordance with the command connected with David, Gad the king’s seer,[a] and Nathan the prophet. This command came from Yahweh through his prophets.

public_domain_references.bsb: Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet. For the command had come from the LORD through His prophets.
public_domain_references.web: He set the Levites in Yahweh’s house with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was from Yahweh by his prophets.
public_domain_references.asv: And he set the Levites in the house of Jehovah with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was of Jehovah by his prophets.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for [so was] the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, and lutes, and harps, according to the commandment of king David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for by the commandment of the Lord the order [was] in the hand of the prophets.

pob.text: Then the Levites stood with the instruments of David[b][a], and the priests with the trumpets.

spob.text: Then the Levites took their places with the musical instruments associated with David, and the priests took their places with the trumpets.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
public_domain_references.web: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.
public_domain_references.asv: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

pob.text: Then Hezekiah commanded to offer up the burnt offering on the altar[a]. And at the time the burnt offering began, the song of Yahweh began also[b], with the trumpets and by means of the instruments of David king of Israel.

spob.text: Then Hezekiah gave the command to offer up the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the song of Yahweh[a] also began, accompanied by trumpets and the musical instruments of David king of Israel.

public_domain_references.web: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt-offering upon the altar. And when the burnt-offering began, the song of Jehovah began also, and the trumpets, together with the instruments of David king of Israel.

public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias told [them] to offer up the whole-burnt-offering on the altar: and when they began to offer the whole-burnt-offering, they began to sing to the Lord, and the trumpets [accompanied] the instruments of David king of Israel.

pob.text: And all the assembly was bowing down[a], while the song was being sung and the trumpets were sounding—all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

spob.text: All the people gathered there bowed down. At the same time, the song was sung and the trumpets sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

public_domain_references.bsb: The whole assembly was worshiping, the singers were singing, and the trumpeters were playing. All this continued until the burnt offering was completed.
public_domain_references.web: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
public_domain_references.asv: And all the assembly worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded; all this [continued] until the burnt-offering was finished.
public_domain_references.kjv: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: [and] all [this continued] until the burnt offering was finished.
public_domain_references.brenton: And all the congregation worshipped, and the psalm-singers [were] singing, and the trumpets sounding, until the whole-burnt-sacrifice had been completely offered.

pob.text: And when they had finished offering[b][a], the king and all who were present with him knelt down and worshiped.

spob.text: When the burnt offering was finished, the king and everyone with him knelt and worshiped.[a]

public_domain_references.kjv: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
public_domain_references.brenton: And when they had done offering [it], the king and all that were present bowed, and worshipped.

pob.text: Then Hezekiah the king and the officials told the Levites to praise Yahweh with the words of David and of Asaph the seer[a]. So they praised with gladness[b], and they bowed down and worshiped.

spob.text: Then King Hezekiah and the officials told the Levites to use the words of David and Asaph the seer[a] to praise Yahweh. The Levites joyfully praised Yahweh. Then they bowed down and worshiped.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing praises to the LORD in the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed their heads and worshiped.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to Yahweh with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.
public_domain_references.asv: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises unto Jehovah with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
public_domain_references.brenton: And king Ezekias and the princes told the Levites to sing hymns to the Lord in the words of David, and of Asaph the prophet: and they sang hymns with gladness, and fell down and worshipped.

pob.text: Then Hezekiah answered and said[a], “Now you have filled your hand for Yahweh. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the house of Yahweh.” And the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all who were willing of heart brought burnt offerings.

spob.text: Then Hezekiah responded, “Now you have dedicated yourselves to Yahweh for sacred service. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to Yahweh’s house, the temple.” So the gathered people brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and everyone whose heart was willing brought burnt offerings.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Hezekiah said, “Now that you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.” So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings.
public_domain_references.web: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to Yahweh. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into Yahweh’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

And the assembly brought in sacrifices and thank-offerings; and as many as were of a willing heart [brought] burnt-offerings.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
public_domain_references.brenton: Then Ezekias answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves to the Lord, bring near and offer sacrifices of praise in the house of the Lord. And the congregation brought sacrifices and thank-offerings into the house of the Lord; and every one who was ready in his heart [brought] whole-burnt-offerings.

pob.text: And the number of the burnt offerings that the assembly brought was seventy cattle, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs; all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

spob.text: In all, the assembly brought 70 cattle, 100 rams, and 200 lambs as burnt offerings to the LORD.

public_domain_references.bsb: The number of burnt offerings the assembly brought was seventy bulls, a hundred rams, and two hundred lambs; all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

pob.text: And the consecrated offerings were six hundred cattle and three thousand sheep[a][b].

spob.text: There were also 600 cattle and 3,000 sheep set apart as sacred offerings.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And the consecrated offerings were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep.

public_domain_references.kjv: And the consecrated things [were] six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the consecrated calves were six hundred, [and] the sheep three thousand.

pob.text: Only the priests were too few[a], and they were not able to skin all the burnt offerings, so their brothers the Levites supported them until the work was finished and until the priests had consecrated themselves[b]. For the Levites were more upright in heart to consecrate themselves than the priests.

spob.text: There were too few priests to skin all the animals for the burnt offerings. So their brothers, the Levites,[a] strengthened them by helping with the work until it was finished and the priests had made themselves ready for sacred service. The Levites were more sincere than the priests in consecrating themselves.

public_domain_references.bsb: However, since there were not enough priests to skin all the burnt offerings, their Levite brothers helped them until the work was finished and until the priests had been consecrated. public_domain_references.kjv: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the [other] priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites [were] more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

pob.text: And the burnt offerings were also in abundance[a], with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings for the burnt offerings. So the service of the house of Yahweh was established.

spob.text: There were also many burnt offerings, together with the fat portions from the peace offerings[a] and the drink offerings that accompanied the burnt offerings. In this way, the worship in Yahweh’s temple was put back in proper order.

public_domain_references.kjv: And also the burnt offerings [were] in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for [every] burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

pob.text: And Hezekiah rejoiced[a], and all the people, because God had prepared for the people, for the matter had happened suddenly.

spob.text: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because God had made all this ready for them. It had happened so quickly.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had prepared for the people, because everything had been accomplished so quickly.
public_domain_references.web: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.
public_domain_references.asv: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, because of that which God had prepared for the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was [done] suddenly.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias and all the people rejoiced, because God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

pob.text: Then Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah[a], and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, to come to the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem to keep the Passover to Yahweh[c][b], the God of Israel.

spob.text: Hezekiah sent a message to all the people of Israel and Judah. He also wrote to the people of Ephraim and Manasseh, telling them to come to the house of Yahweh—the temple in Jerusalem—and celebrate the Passover feast in honor of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Hezekiah sent word throughout all Israel and Judah, and he also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh inviting them to come to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem to keep the Passover of the LORD, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.web: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of Jehovah at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto Jehovah, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias sent to all Israel and Juda, and wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasse, that they should come into the house of the Lord to Jerusalem, to keep the passover to the Lord God of Israel.

pob.text: Then the king and his officials and all the assembly in Jerusalem decided to keep the Passover in the second month[a].

spob.text: The king, his officials, and the whole assembly in Jerusalem decided to observe the Passover in the second month.

public_domain_references.web: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

public_domain_references.brenton: For the king, and the princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, designed to keep the passover in the second month.

pob.text: For they could not do it at that time[a], because the priests had not consecrated themselves sufficiently[b], and the people had not gathered to Jerusalem.

spob.text: The king and the whole assembly thought the proposal was right.

public_domain_references.bsb: This proposal pleased the king and the whole assembly.

pob.text: So they established a decree to send a proclamation throughout all Israel[a], from Beersheba to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem; for they had not kept it in great numbers as it is written.

spob.text: So they decided to send an official announcement throughout Israel, from Beersheba to Dan. The people were to come to Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover for Yahweh, the God of Israel. For they had not celebrated it in large numbers as Scripture directs.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: So they established a decree to circulate a proclamation throughout Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, that the people should come to keep the Passover of the LORD, the God of Israel, in Jerusalem. For they had not observed it as a nation as prescribed.
public_domain_references.web: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the priests and the Levites stood to bless the people, and God heard their voice, and their prayer came into His holy dwelling place in heaven.
public_domain_references.web: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.
public_domain_references.asv: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even unto heaven.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came [up] to his holy dwelling place, [even] unto heaven.
public_domain_references.brenton: Then the priests the Levites rose up and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came into his holy dwelling-place, [even] into heaven.

pob.text: And when all this was finished[a], all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and shattered the pillars, cut down the Asherim, and tore down the high places and the altars throughout all Judah and Benjamin, and in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had completely destroyed them. Then all the sons of Israel returned, each man to his possession, to their cities.

spob.text: When all this was over, all the Israelites who had attended the feast went to the towns of Judah. They smashed the sacred pillars, cut down the objects associated with Asherah,[a] and demolished the places of worship known as high places and the altars throughout all Judah and Benjamin, and in Ephraim and Manasseh. They continued until all these things were completely destroyed. Then all the sons of Israel went back to their own towns, each man to his own property.

public_domain_references.bsb: When all this had ended, the Israelites in attendance went out to the cities of Judah and broke up the sacred pillars, chopped down the Asherah poles, and tore down the high places and altars throughout Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the Israelites returned to their cities, each to his own property.
public_domain_references.web: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

pob.text: And Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites according to their divisions[a], each man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and peace offerings[c][b], to minister and to give thanks and to praise at the gates of the camps of Yahweh.

spob.text: Hezekiah organized the priests and Levites into their assigned groups and gave each man his own duties. Their work included burnt offerings and peace offerings, carrying out sacred service, and giving thanks and praise at the gates of Yahweh’s camps.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Hezekiah reestablished the divisions of the priests and Levites—each of them according to their duties as priests or Levites—for the burnt offerings and peace offerings, for ministry, for giving thanks, and for singing praises at the gates of the LORD’s dwelling.
public_domain_references.web: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of Yahweh’s camp.
public_domain_references.asv: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt-offerings and for peace-offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the camp of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites, and the courses of each one according to his ministry, to the priests and to the Levites, for the whole-burnt-offering, and for the peace-offering, and to praise, and to give thanks, and to minister in the gates [and] in the courts of the house of the Lord.

pob.text: The king’s portion from his own possessions was for the burnt offerings: the burnt offerings of the morning and the evening[a], and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, the new moons, and the appointed feasts[e][d][c][b], as it is written in the Law of Yahweh.

spob.text: The king set aside part of his own possessions to provide the burnt offerings for each morning and evening, and for the Sabbaths, new-moon observances, and appointed festivals, as written in the Law of Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: The king contributed from his own possessions for the regular morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, as written in the Law of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: He also appointed the king’s portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in Yahweh’s law.
public_domain_references.asv: [He appointed] also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt-offerings, [to wit], for the morning and evening burnt-offerings, and the burnt-offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: [He appointed] also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, [to wit], for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as [it is] written in the law of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king's proportion out of his substance [was appointed] for the whole-burnt-offerings, the morning and the evening one, and the whole-burnt-offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the feasts that were ordered in the law of the Lord.

pob.text: He also commanded the people[a], the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to give the portion due to the priests and the Levites, so that they might devote themselves to the law of Yahweh.

spob.text: He also told the people living in Jerusalem to give the priests and Levites the share allotted to them, so that they could devote themselves to Yahweh’s law.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Moreover, he commanded the people living in Jerusalem to make a contribution for the priests and Levites so that they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to Yahweh’s law.
public_domain_references.asv: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to the law of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they told the people who dwelt in Jerusalem, to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be strong in the ministry of the house of the Lord.

pob.text: And when the matter spread[a], the sons of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and all the produce of the field[b]; they brought in abundantly the tithe of everything.

spob.text: When the matter became widely known, the sons of Israel[a] brought large amounts of the first portions of their produce set apart for God: grain, new wine, oil, honey,[b] and all the produce of the fields. They also brought their tithe—a tenth of everything—in great abundance.

public_domain_references.bsb: As soon as the order went out, the Israelites generously provided the firstfruits of the grain, new wine, oil, and honey, and of all the produce of the field, and they brought in an abundance—a tithe of everything.
public_domain_references.web: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly.
public_domain_references.asv: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first-fruits of grain, new wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all [things] brought they in abundantly.
public_domain_references.brenton: And as he gave the command, Israel brought abundantly first-fruits of corn, and wine, and oil, and honey, and every fruit of the field: and the children of Israel and Juda brought tithes of everything abundantly.

pob.text: And the people of Israel and Judah who lived in the cities of Judah also brought the tithe of cattle and sheep[a], and the tithe of the holy things consecrated to Yahweh their God, and they laid them in heaps[b], heap upon heap.

spob.text: The people of Israel and Judah who lived in Judah’s cities also brought one tenth of the cattle and sheep. They also brought one tenth of the holy gifts[a] dedicated to Yahweh their God. They put everything into many heaps, heap upon heap.

public_domain_references.bsb: And the Israelites and Judahites who lived in the cities of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things consecrated to the LORD their God, and they laid them in large heaps.
public_domain_references.web: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to Yahweh their God, and laid them in heaps.
public_domain_references.asv: And the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated unto Jehovah their God, and laid them by heaps.
public_domain_references.kjv: And [concerning] the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid [them] by heaps.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they that dwelt in the cities of Juda themselves also brought tithes of calves and sheep, and tithes of goats, and consecrated them to the Lord their God, and they brought them and laid them in heaps.

pob.text: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps[b][a], and in the seventh month they finished them.

spob.text: In the third month, they began forming the heaps of contributed produce, starting with the base. They finished the heaps in the seventh month.

public_domain_references.bsb: In the third month they began building up the heaps, and they finished in the seventh month.

public_domain_references.brenton: In the third month the heaps began to be piled, and in the seventh month they were finished.

pob.text: When Hezekiah and the officials came and saw the heaps[b][a], they blessed Yahweh and his people Israel.

spob.text: Hezekiah and the officials came and saw the heaps of contributions. Then they blessed Yahweh and his people Israel.[a]

public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias and the princes came and saw the heaps, and blessed the Lord, and his people Israel.

pob.text: And Hezekiah asked the priests and the Levites about the heaps.

pob.text: Azariah the chief priest[a], of the house of Zadok, said to him, “Since they began bringing the contribution into the house of Yahweh, we have eaten and been satisfied and have had plenty left over, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and what is left is this great abundance.”

spob.text: Azariah, the chief priest from Zadok’s family, answered him, “Ever since they began bringing the sacred contributions into Yahweh’s temple, we have eaten all we need and still have plenty left over. Yahweh has blessed his people, and this huge amount is still left.”

public_domain_references.bsb: and Azariah, the chief priest of the household of Zadok, answered him, “Since the people began to bring their contributions into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and there is plenty left over, because the LORD has blessed His people; this great abundance is what is left over.”
public_domain_references.web: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into Yahweh’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”
public_domain_references.asv: And Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, Since [the people] began to bring the oblations into the house of Jehovah, we have eaten and had enough, and have left plenty: for Jehovah hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since [the people] began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left [is] this great store.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Azarias the priest, the chief over the house of Sadoc, spoke to him, and said, From the time that the first-fruits began to be brought into the house of the Lord, we have eaten and drunk, and left even abundantly; for the Lord has blessed his people, and we have left to this amount.

pob.text: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare chambers in the house of Yahweh[b][a], and they prepared them.

spob.text: Then Hezekiah ordered that rooms in Yahweh’s temple be made ready, and they made them ready.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare storerooms in the house of the LORD, and they did so.
public_domain_references.web: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in Yahweh’s house, and they prepared them.

public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias told them yet farther to prepare chambers for the house of the Lord; and they prepared [them],

pob.text: They brought in the contribution[a], the tithe, and the holy things faithfully, and Conaniah the Levite was chief over them[b], with his brother Shimei second.

spob.text: They faithfully brought in the contribution, the tithe—the tenth given to God—and the sacred gifts. Conaniah the Levite was in charge of them, and his brother Shimei was second in command.

public_domain_references.bsb: And they faithfully brought in the contributions, tithes, and dedicated gifts. Conaniah the Levite was the officer in charge of them, and his brother Shimei was second.

pob.text: Jehiel[a], Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah[b], Mahath, and Benaiah were officers under the authority of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of King Hezekiah and Azariah, the chief officer of the house of God.

spob.text: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath, and Benaiah served as officers under Conaniah and his brother Shimei. They were appointed[a] by King Hezekiah and Azariah, the chief officer of the house of God.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, [were] overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Jeiel, and Ozias, and Naeth, and Asael, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Samachia, and Maath, and Banaias, and his sons, were appointed by Chonenias and Semei his brother, as Ezekias the king, and Azarias who was over the house of the Lord commanded.

pob.text: Kore son of Imnah[a], the Levite, the gatekeeper on the east, was in charge of the freewill offerings of God[b], to distribute the contribution of Yahweh and the most holy things.

spob.text: Kore son of Imnah was a Levite and the gatekeeper on the east side. He was responsible for the offerings people freely gave to God. He distributed the contribution dedicated to Yahweh and the things set apart as most holy.

public_domain_references.bsb: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions to the LORD and the consecrated gifts.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, [was] over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Core, the [son] of Jemna the Levite, the porter eastward, [was] over the gifts, to distribute the first-fruits of the Lord, and the most holy things,

pob.text: Under his authority were Eden[a], Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, faithfully to distribute to their brothers by divisions[c][b], to great and small alike.

pob.text: And for the sons of Aaron[a], the priests, in the pasture lands of their cities, in every city[e][d][c][b], there were men designated by name to give portions to every male among the priests and to everyone enrolled by genealogy among the Levites.

public_domain_references.kjv: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, [which were] in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

pob.text: And many were bringing an offering to Yahweh in Jerusalem[a], and choice gifts to Hezekiah king of Judah[b], and after this he was exalted in the sight of all the nations.

public_domain_references.brenton: In those days Ezekias was sick even to death, and prayed to the Lord: and he hearkened to him, and gave him a sign.

public_domain_references.brenton: But Ezekias did not recompense the Lord according to the return which he made him, but his heart was lifted up: and wrath came upon him, and upon Juda and Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias humbled himself after the exaltation of his heart, he and the dwellers in Jerusalem; and the wrath of the Lord did not come upon them in the days of Ezekias.

pob.text: And Hezekiah had very great wealth and honor[a], and he made storehouses for silver and gold, precious stones, spices, shields[b], and every desirable article.

spob.text: He also built cities for himself and acquired large numbers of flocks and herds. This was because God had given him very great wealth.

pob.text: It was Hezekiah who stopped up the upper outlet of the waters of Gihon and directed them down to the west side of the city of David[b][a]. And Hezekiah prospered in all his work.

pob.text: And so[a], in the matter of the envoys of the princes of Babylon, who had been sent to him to inquire about the sign that had happened in the land, God left him, to test him[b], to know all that was in his heart.

pob.text: The rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his faithful deeds—behold[a], they are written in the vision of Isaiah son of Amoz, the prophet, in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

pob.text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers[a], and they buried him in the upper part of the tombs of the sons of David. And all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

public_domain_references.brenton: And Ezekias slept with his fathers, and they buried him in a high place among the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem gave him glory and honour at his death. And Manasses his son reigned in his stead.

pob.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

spob.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-five years.

public_domain_references.bsb: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years.

pob.text: He made his sons pass through the fire in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom[a], practiced soothsaying and divination and sorcery, and dealt with mediums and spiritists. He multiplied doing what was evil in the eyes of Yahweh[b], provoking him to anger.

pob.text: He put the carved image[a], the idol that he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.”

pob.text: And I will no longer remove the foot of Israel from upon the land that I appointed for your fathers[a], if only they are careful to do all that I commanded them[b], according to all the law and the statutes and the judgments given through Moses.

public_domain_references.web: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”
