public_domain_references.kjv: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord spoke to Manasses, and to his people: but they hearkened not.

pob.text: So Yahweh brought against them the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria[a], and they captured Manasseh with hooks, bound him with bronze chains, and took him to Babylon.

spob.text: So Yahweh sent the Assyrian king’s army commanders against them. They captured Manasseh with hooks,[a] put him in bronze chains, and took him to Babylon.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the LORD brought against them the military commanders of the king of Assyria, who captured Manasseh, put a hook in his nose, bound him with bronze shackles, and took him to Babylon.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore Jehovah brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, and they took Manasses in bonds, and bound him in fetters, and brought him to Babylon.

pob.text: And when he was in distress[b][a], he sought the favor of Yahweh his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

spob.text: When he was in trouble, he asked Yahweh his God to show him favor. He humbled himself deeply before the God of his fathers.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And in his distress, Manasseh sought the favor of the LORD his God and earnestly humbled himself before the God of his fathers.
public_domain_references.web: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
public_domain_references.asv: And when he was in distress, he besought Jehovah his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
public_domain_references.brenton: And when he was afflicted, he sought the face of the Lord his God, and was greatly humbled before the face of the God of his fathers;

pob.text: He prayed to him[a], and he was moved by his entreaty, heard his supplication, and brought him back to Jerusalem to his kingdom[c][b]. Then Manasseh knew that Yahweh is God.

spob.text: Manasseh prayed to God. God was moved by his plea and heard his request for mercy. He brought Manasseh back to Jerusalem and restored him as king. Then Manasseh knew that Yahweh is God.

public_domain_references.bsb: And when he prayed to Him, the LORD received his plea and heard his petition; so He brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD is God.
public_domain_references.web: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahweh was God.
public_domain_references.asv: And he prayed unto him; and he was entreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Jehovah he was God.
public_domain_references.kjv: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he [was] God.
public_domain_references.brenton: and he prayed to him: and he hearkened to him, and listened to his cry, and brought him back to Jerusalem to his kingdom: and Manasses knew that the Lord he is God.

pob.text: After this he built an outer wall for the city of David[a], west of Gihon in the valley, as far as the entrance of the Fish Gate; it went around Ophel, and he made it very high[c][b]. He also placed military commanders in all the fortified cities in Judah.

spob.text: After this, he built a very high outer wall for the City of David. It ran west of Gihon in the valley, continued as far as the entrance to the Fish Gate, and went around Ophel.[a] He also stationed military commanders in every fortified city in Judah.

public_domain_references.bsb: After this, Manasseh rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David from west of Gihon in the valley to the entrance of the Fish Gate, and he brought it around the hill of Ophel and heightened it considerably. He also stationed military commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah.
public_domain_references.web: Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.
public_domain_references.asv: Now after this he built an outer wall to the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate; and he compassed Ophel about [with it], and raised it up to a very great height: and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.
public_domain_references.brenton: And afterward he built a wall without the city of David, from the southwest southward in the valleys and at the entrance through the fish-gate, as men go out by the gate round about, even as far as Opel; and he raised it much, and set captains of the host in all the fortified cities in Juda.

pob.text: He removed the foreign gods and the idol from the house of Yahweh[a], and all the altars that he had built on the mountain of the house of Yahweh and in Jerusalem[b], and he threw them outside the city.

spob.text: He removed the foreign gods and the idol[a] from Yahweh’s temple. He also removed all the altars he had built on the temple mount and in Jerusalem. Then he threw them outside the city.

public_domain_references.bsb: He removed the foreign gods and the idol from the house of the LORD, along with all the altars he had built on the temple mount and in Jerusalem, and he dumped them outside the city.
public_domain_references.web: He took away the foreign gods and the idol out of Yahweh’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of Yahweh’s house and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
public_domain_references.asv: And he took away the foreign gods, and the idol out of the house of Jehovah, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of Jehovah, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast [them] out of the city.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he removed the strange gods and the graven [image] out of the house of the Lord, and all the altars which he had built in the mount of the house of the Lord, and in Jerusalem, and without the city.

pob.text: Then he restored the altar of Yahweh and sacrificed on it sacrifices of peace offerings and thanksgiving[a], and he told Judah to serve Yahweh[b], the God of Israel.

spob.text: Then he restored Yahweh’s altar. He offered peace offerings[a] and thank offerings on it, and he told the people of Judah to serve Yahweh, the God of Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then he restored the altar of the LORD and sacrificed peace offerings and thank offerings on it, and he told Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.web: He built up Yahweh’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve Yahweh, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: And he built up the altar of Jehovah, and offered thereon sacrifices of peace-offerings and of thanksgiving, and commanded Judah to serve Jehovah, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he repaired the altar of the Lord, and offered upon it a sacrifice of peace-offering and thank-offering, and he told Juda to serve the Lord God of Israel.

pob.text: Nevertheless[a], the people still sacrificed at the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.

spob.text: Even so, the people continued to offer sacrifices at the unauthorized local worship sites called high places. But they offered them only to Yahweh their God.

public_domain_references.bsb: Nevertheless, the people still sacrificed at the high places, but only to the LORD their God.
public_domain_references.web: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.
public_domain_references.asv: Nevertheless the people sacrificed still in the high places, but only unto Jehovah their God.
public_domain_references.kjv: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, [yet] unto the LORD their God only.
public_domain_references.brenton: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed on the high places, only to the Lord their God.

pob.text: The rest of the acts of Manasseh[a], and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel—behold, they are written among the records of the kings of Israel.

spob.text: Everything else Manasseh did, his prayer to his God, and what the seers[a] said to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel—all of this can be found in the written records of the kings of Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh, along with his prayer to his God and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, they are indeed written in the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
public_domain_references.web: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they [are written] in the book of the kings of Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the rest of the acts of Manasses, and his prayer to God, and the words of the seers that spoke to him in the name of the God of Israel,

pob.text: And his prayer[a], and how he was entreated, and all his sin and his unfaithfulness, and the places where he built high places and set up the Asherim and the carved images before he humbled himself—behold[b], they are written in the records of the seers.

spob.text: His prayer and the answer he received, all his sins and unfaithfulness, and the places where he built worship shrines and set up Asherah objects[a] and carved images before he humbled himself—all this is written in the records of the seers.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: His prayer and how God received his plea, as well as all his sin and unfaithfulness, and the sites where he built high places and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself, they are indeed written in the Records of the Seers.
public_domain_references.web: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.
public_domain_references.asv: His prayer also, and how [God] was entreated of him, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up the Asherim and the graven images, before he humbled himself, behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.
public_domain_references.kjv: His prayer also, and [how God] was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they [are] written among the sayings of the seers.
public_domain_references.brenton: behold, [they are] in the account of his prayer; and [God] hearkened to him. And all his sins, and his backslidings, and the spots on which he built the high places, and set there groves and graven images, before he repented, behold, they are written in the books of the seers.

pob.text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers[a], and they buried him in his house. And Amon his son reigned in his place.

spob.text: Manasseh fell asleep in death with his fathers, and they buried him in his house.[a] His son Amon became king in his place.

public_domain_references.bsb: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried at his palace. And his son Amon reigned in his place.
public_domain_references.web: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
public_domain_references.asv: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Manasses slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the garden of his house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

pob.text: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

spob.text: Amon became king at age twenty-two. He ruled in Jerusalem for two years.

public_domain_references.bsb: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.
public_domain_references.web: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Amon [was] two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

pob.text: He did what was evil in the sight of Yahweh[a], just as Manasseh his father had done[b]. Amon sacrificed to all the carved images that Manasseh his father had made and served them.

spob.text: Amon did what Yahweh considered evil, just as his father Manasseh had done. He sacrificed to all the carved images his father had made and served them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh had done. Amon served and sacrificed to all the idols that his father Manasseh had made,
public_domain_references.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.
public_domain_references.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed unto all the graven images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.
public_domain_references.kjv: But he did [that which was] evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
public_domain_references.brenton: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasses did: and Amon sacrificed to all the idols which his father Manasses had made, and served them.

pob.text: But he did not humble himself before Yahweh as his father Manasseh humbled himself[a], for he, Amon, increased guilt.

spob.text: But Amon did not humble himself before Yahweh as his father Manasseh had done.[a] For Amon increased his guilt.

public_domain_references.bsb: but he did not humble himself before the LORD as his father Manasseh had done; instead, Amon increased his guilt.
public_domain_references.web: He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.
public_domain_references.asv: And he humbled not himself before Jehovah, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.
public_domain_references.kjv: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he was not humbled before the Lord as his father Manasses was humbled; for his son Amon abounded in transgression.

pob.text: And his servants conspired against him and put him to death in his own house.

spob.text: His servants joined together in a plot against him. They put him to death inside his own house.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed him in his palace.
public_domain_references.web: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.
public_domain_references.asv: And his servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.
public_domain_references.kjv: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
public_domain_references.brenton: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his house.

pob.text: But the people of the land struck down all those who had conspired against King Amon[b][a], and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

spob.text: But the people of the land[a] killed everyone who had plotted against King Amon. Then they made Amon’s son Josiah king in his place.

public_domain_references.bsb: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon, and they made his son Josiah king in his place.
public_domain_references.web: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
public_domain_references.asv: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the people of the land slew the men who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josias his son king in his stead.

pob.text: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

spob.text: Josiah became king when he was eight years old. He ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-one years.

public_domain_references.bsb: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.
public_domain_references.web: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: Josiah [was] eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.
public_domain_references.brenton: Josias was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

pob.text: He did what was right in the eyes of Yahweh[a], and walked in the ways of David his father[b]; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.

spob.text: He did what was right in Yahweh’s eyes. He followed the path of his ancestor David and did not turn from it to the right or the left.

public_domain_references.bsb: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
public_domain_references.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.
public_domain_references.asv: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, and walked in the ways of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he did [that which was] right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined [neither] to the right hand, nor to the left.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of his father David, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

pob.text: In the eighth year of his reign[a], while he was still a youth, he began to seek the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherim, the carved images[c][b], and the metal images.

spob.text: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the God of David his father.[a] In the twelfth year of his reign, he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem by removing the shrines on the high places, the Asherah symbols,[b] the carved images, and the metal images.

public_domain_references.bsb: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his father David, and in the twelfth year he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images.
public_domain_references.web: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.
public_domain_references.asv: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the Asherim, and the graven images, and the molten images.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
public_domain_references.brenton: And in the eighth year of his reign, and he [being] yet a youth, he began to seek the Lord God of his father David: and in the twelfth year of his reign he began to purge Juda and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the ornaments for the altars, and the molten images.

pob.text: They tore down before him the altars of the Baals[a], and he cut down the incense altars that were above them. He shattered and crushed the Asherim, the carved images, and the metal images[b], and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

spob.text: While Josiah was there, they tore down the altars of the Baals. He cut down the incense altars[a] that stood above them. He shattered the Asherim[b], the carved images, and the metal images, then crushed them into small pieces. He scattered the pieces over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then in his presence the altars of the Baals were torn down, and he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them. He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust, and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
public_domain_references.web: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and he cut down the incense altars that were on high above them. He broke the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
public_domain_references.asv: And they brake down the altars of the Baalim in his presence; and the sun-images that were on high above them he hewed down; and the Asherim, and the graven images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strewed it upon the graves [of them] that had sacrificed unto them.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that [were] on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust [of them], and strowed [it] upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he pulled down the altars of Baalim that were before his face, and the high places that were above them; and he cut down the groves, and the graven images, and broke in pieces the molten images, and reduced them to powder, and cast [it] upon the surface of the tombs of those who [had] sacrificed to them.

pob.text: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars[a], and he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

spob.text: He burned the priests’ bones on their altars.[a] He cleansed Judah and Jerusalem from the defilement of false worship.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then he burned the bones of the priests on their altars. So he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.web: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon the altars, and purged Juda and Jerusalem.

pob.text: and in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon[a], even as far as Naphtali[b], in their surrounding ruins.

spob.text: He also did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around those cities.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Josiah did the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them.
public_domain_references.web: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.
public_domain_references.asv: And [so did he] in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, in their ruins round about.
public_domain_references.kjv: And [so did he] in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
public_domain_references.brenton: And [he did so] in the cities of Manasse, and Ephraim, and Symeon, and Nephthali, and the places round about them.

pob.text: He tore down the altars and the Asherim[a], and he crushed the carved images to powder; he cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel[b]. Then he returned to Jerusalem.

spob.text: He tore down the altars and the objects associated with Asherah.[a] He crushed the carved images into powder and cut down all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel.[b] Then he returned to Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.bsb: He tore down the altars and Asherah poles, crushed the idols to powder, and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.web: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: And he brake down the altars, and beat the Asherim and the graven images into powder, and hewed down all the sun-images throughout all the land of Israel, and returned to Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he pulled down the altars and the groves, and he cut the idols in small pieces, and cut off all the high places from all the land of Israel, and returned to Jerusalem.

pob.text: In the eighteenth year of his reign[a], when he had cleansed the land and the house, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder[b], to repair the house of Yahweh his God.

spob.text: In the eighteenth year of his reign, after he had cleansed the land and the temple, Josiah sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the city governor, and Joah son of Joahaz, the record keeper, to have the temple repaired—the house of Yahweh his God.

public_domain_references.web: “Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.”’” They brought back this message to the king.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof. And they brought back word to the king.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, I [will] gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, and thine eyes shall not look upon all the evils which I am bringing upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of it. And they brought back word to the king.

pob.text: Then the king sent and gathered all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem[a].

spob.text: Then the king sent word and brought together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.web: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king sent and gathered the elders of Juda and Jerusalem.

pob.text: Then the king went up to the house of Yahweh[a], and every man of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and the Levites, and all the people, from great to small[b]; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that had been found in the house of Yahweh.

spob.text: Then the king went up to Yahweh’s house, the temple. Every man of Judah went with him, along with the residents of Jerusalem, the priests, the Levites, and all the people, from the most important to the least. He read aloud to them every word of the book of the covenant that had been found in Yahweh’s house.

public_domain_references.bsb: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, as well as the priests and the Levites—all the people small and great—and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: The king went up to Yahweh’s house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests, the Levites, and all the people, both great and small—and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in Yahweh’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king went up to the house of Jehovah, and all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, both great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, [he] and all Juda, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that were found in the house of the Lord.

pob.text: Then the king stood in his place and made the covenant before Yahweh[a], to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to carry out the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

spob.text: Then the king stood in his appointed place and made the covenant before Yahweh. He promised to follow Yahweh and to obey his commandments, covenant requirements, and prescribed laws with all his heart and soul. He would carry out the terms of the covenant written in this book.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow the LORD and to keep His commandments, decrees, and statutes with all his heart and all his soul, and to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book.
public_domain_references.web: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before Jehovah, to walk after Jehovah, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the king stood at a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk before the Lord, to keep his commandments and testimonies, and his ordinances, with all [his] heart and with all [his] soul, so as to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

pob.text: Then he made everyone who was found in Jerusalem and Benjamin stand to it[a], and the inhabitants of Jerusalem acted according to the covenant of God[b], the God of their fathers.

spob.text: Then he required everyone present in Jerusalem and the territory of Benjamin to stand by the covenant. The people of Jerusalem did what was required by the covenant of God, the God of their ancestors.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin take a stand in agreement to it. So all the people of Jerusalem carried out the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.web: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.asv: And he caused all that were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand [to it]. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand [to it]. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he caused all that were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand; and the inhabitants of Jerusalem made a covenant in the house of the Lord God of their fathers.

pob.text: And Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands that belonged to the sons of Israel[a], and he made all who were found in Israel serve Yahweh their God. All his days they did not turn away from following Yahweh[d][c][b], the God of their fathers.

spob.text: Josiah removed all the detestable things from every territory belonging to the sons of Israel. He made everyone in Israel serve Yahweh their God. As long as Josiah lived, the people did not turn away from following Yahweh, the God of their fathers.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands belonging to the Israelites, and he required everyone in Israel to serve the LORD their God. Throughout his reign they did not turn aside from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.web: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve Yahweh their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.asv: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were found in Israel to serve, even to serve Jehovah their God. All his days they departed not from following Jehovah, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that [pertained] to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, [even] to serve the LORD their God. [And] all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Josias removed all the abominations out of the whole land which belonged to the children of Israel, and caused all that were found in Jerusalem and in Israel, to serve the Lord their God all his days: he departed not from following the Lord God of his fathers.

pob.text: Josiah kept the Passover to Yahweh in Jerusalem[a], and they slaughtered the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

spob.text: Josiah celebrated the Passover in honor of Yahweh in Jerusalem. On the fourteenth day of the first month, they slaughtered the Passover lamb.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Josiah celebrated the Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem, and the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the first month.
public_domain_references.web: Josiah kept a Passover to Yahweh in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
public_domain_references.asv: And Josiah kept a passover unto Jehovah in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth [day] of the first month.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth [day] of the first month.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Josias kept a passover to the Lord his God; and sacrificed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

pob.text: He appointed the priests to their duties and strengthened them for the service of the house of Yahweh[a][b].

spob.text: He gave the priests their assigned duties and strengthened them to do their work in Yahweh’s temple.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: He appointed the priests to their duties and encouraged them in the service of the house of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of Yahweh’s house.
public_domain_references.asv: And he set the priests in their offices, and encouraged them to the service of the house of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,
public_domain_references.brenton: And he appointed the priests at their charges, and encouraged them for the services of the house of the Lord.

pob.text: And he said to the Levites who taught all Israel[a], who were holy to Yahweh, “Put the holy ark in the house that Solomon son of David, king of Israel, built. You no longer have to carry it on your shoulders[c][b]. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.”

spob.text: He told the Levites who taught all Israel[a] and were set apart for Yahweh, “Place the holy ark in the temple built by Solomon son of David, king of Israel. You no longer need to carry it on your shoulders. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.”

public_domain_references.bsb: To the Levites who taught all Israel and were holy to the LORD, Josiah said: “Put the holy ark in the temple built by Solomon son of David king of Israel. It is not to be carried around on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and His people Israel.
public_domain_references.web: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to Yahweh, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: And he said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, that were holy unto Jehovah, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; there shall no more be a burden upon your shoulders. Now serve Jehovah your God, and his people Israel;
public_domain_references.kjv: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; [it shall] not [be] a burden upon [your] shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,
public_domain_references.brenton: And he told the Levites that were able [to act] in all Israel, that they should consecrate themselves to the Lord: and they put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built: and the king said, Ye must not carry anything on your shoulders: now then minister to the Lord your God, and to his people Israel.

pob.text: Prepare yourselves by your fathers’ houses according to your divisions[b][a], as prescribed in the writing of David king of Israel and in the writing of Solomon his son.

spob.text: Prepare yourselves by organizing into your ancestral families and assigned groups, as prescribed in the written instructions of David king of Israel and his son Solomon.

public_domain_references.bsb: Prepare yourselves by families in your divisions, according to the instructions written by David king of Israel and Solomon his son.
public_domain_references.web: Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
public_domain_references.asv: and prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
public_domain_references.kjv: And prepare [yourselves] by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
public_domain_references.brenton: And prepare yourselves according to the houses of your families, and according to your daily courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and [the order] by the hand of his son Solomon.

pob.text: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers[a], the sons of the people, and according to the division of a father’s house for the Levites.

spob.text: Take your places in the holy place. Arrange yourselves according to the divisions of the ancestral families of your brothers—the sons of the people[a]—and according to the family divisions of the Levites.

public_domain_references.bsb: Moreover, stand in the Holy Place by the divisions of the families of your kinsmen the lay people, and by the divisions of the families of the Levites.
public_domain_references.web: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.
public_domain_references.asv: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brethren the children of the people, and [let there be for each] a portion of a father’s house of the Levites.
public_domain_references.kjv: And stand in the holy [place] according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and [after] the division of the families of the Levites.
public_domain_references.brenton: And stand ye in the house according to the divisions of the houses of your families for your brethren the sons of the people; [so] also let there be for the Levites a division of the house of their family.

pob.text: Slaughter the Passover lamb[a], consecrate yourselves, and prepare for your brothers[b], to do according to the word of Yahweh by the hand of Moses.

spob.text: Slaughter the Passover lamb, prepare yourselves for sacred service, and prepare what your brothers need so that they can observe the Passover as Yahweh instructed through Moses.

public_domain_references.bsb: Slaughter the Passover lambs, consecrate yourselves, and make preparations for your fellow countrymen to carry out the word of the LORD given by Moses.”
public_domain_references.web: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to Yahweh’s word by Moses.”
public_domain_references.asv: And kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brethren, to do according to the word of Jehovah by Moses.
public_domain_references.kjv: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that [they] may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
public_domain_references.brenton: And kill ye the passover, and prepare [it] for your brethren, to do according to the word of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.

pob.text: Josiah contributed to the people from the flock[a], lambs and young goats, all of them for the Passover offerings, for all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand cattle[b]. These were from the king’s possessions.

spob.text: Josiah provided the people who were present with 30,000 lambs and young goats for the Passover offerings, along with 3,000 cattle. All these animals came from the king’s possessions.

public_domain_references.bsb: From his own flocks and herds Josiah contributed 30,000 lambs and goats plus 3,000 bulls for the Passover offerings for all the people who were present.
public_domain_references.web: Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and young goats, all of them for the Passover offerings, to all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls. These were of the king’s substance.
public_domain_references.asv: And Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all of them for the passover-offerings, unto all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king’s substance.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these [were] of the king’s substance.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Josias gave as an offering to the children of the people, sheep, and lambs, and kids of the young of the goats, all for the passover, [even for] all that were found, in number [amounting to] thirty thousand, and three thousand calves, these [were] of the substance of the king.

pob.text: And his officials contributed a freewill offering for the people[a], for the priests, and for the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the leaders of the house of God[b], gave to the priests 2,600 Passover offerings and 300 cattle.

spob.text: His officials also made voluntary contributions for the people,[a] the priests, and the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the leaders of God’s temple, gave the priests 2,600 animals for the Passover offerings and 300 cattle.

public_domain_references.bsb: His officials also contributed willingly to the people and priests and Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the administrators of the house of God, gave the priests 2,600 Passover offerings and 300 bulls.
public_domain_references.web: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.
public_domain_references.asv: And his princes gave for a freewill-offering unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, the rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover-offerings two thousand and six hundred [small cattle], and three hundred oxen.
public_domain_references.kjv: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred [small cattle], and three hundred oxen.
public_domain_references.brenton: And his princes gave an offering to the people, and to the priests, and to the Levites: and Chelcias and Zacharias and Jeiel the chief men gave to the priests of the house of God, they even gave for the passover sheep, and lambs, and kids, two thousand six hundred, and three hundred calves.

pob.text: Conaniah[a], and Shemaiah and Nethanel his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, contributed to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand and five hundred head of cattle.

spob.text: Conaniah, his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad were leaders of the Levites. They gave the Levites 5,000 animals for the Passover offerings, along with 500 cattle.

public_domain_references.bsb: Additionally, Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, as well as Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, officers of the Levites, donated to the Levites 5,000 Passover offerings and 500 bulls.
public_domain_references.web: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.
public_domain_references.asv: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for the passover-offerings five thousand [small cattle], and five hundred oxen.
public_domain_references.kjv: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand [small cattle], and five hundred oxen.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Chonenias, and Banæas, and Samæas, and Nathanael his brother, and Asabias, and Jeiel, and Jozabad, heads of the Levites, gave an offering to the Levites for the passover, of five thousand sheep and five hundred calves.

pob.text: So the service was prepared[a], and the priests stood at their stations, and the Levites by their divisions[c][b], according to the command of the king.

spob.text: So the worship service was ready. The priests took their assigned places, and the Levites stood in their organized groups, as the king had commanded.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the service was prepared; the priests stood in their places and the Levites in their divisions according to the king’s command.
public_domain_references.web: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.
public_domain_references.asv: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their courses, according to the king’s commandment.
public_domain_references.kjv: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king’s commandment.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the service was duly ordered, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their divisions, according to the command of the king.

pob.text: And they slaughtered the Passover lamb[a], and the priests splashed the blood from their hands[c][b], while the Levites were skinning them.

spob.text: They slaughtered the Passover lambs[a]. The priests received the blood from them and splashed it on the altar, while the Levites skinned the animals.

public_domain_references.bsb: And they slaughtered the Passover lambs, while the priests sprinkled the blood handed to them and the Levites skinned the animals.
public_domain_references.web: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.
public_domain_references.asv: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled [the blood which they received] of their hand, and the Levites flayed them.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled [the blood] from their hands, and the Levites flayed [them].
public_domain_references.brenton: And they slew the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hand, and the Levites flayed [the victims].

pob.text: They removed the burnt offerings[a], to give them by divisions of the fathers’ houses to the sons of the people, to present to Yahweh, as it is written in the Book of Moses; and so also with the cattle.

spob.text: They removed the burnt offerings and gave them to the sons of the people[a] according to their ancestral family groups, for presentation to Yahweh as written in the Book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

public_domain_references.bsb: They set aside the burnt offerings to be given to the divisions of the families of the people to offer to the LORD, as is written in the Book of Moses; and they did the same with the bulls.
public_domain_references.web: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to Yahweh, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.
public_domain_references.asv: And they removed the burnt-offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer unto Jehovah, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as [it is] written in the book of Moses. And so [did they] with the oxen.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they prepared the whole-burnt-offering to give to them, according to the division by the houses of families, [even] to the sons of the people, to offer to the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses.

pob.text: They cooked the Passover lamb in the fire according to the rule[a], and they boiled the holy offerings in pots, kettles, and bowls, and quickly brought them to all the people.

spob.text: They used fire to cook the Passover lamb, as the law required.[a] They boiled the other holy offerings in pots, large kettles, and bowls. Then they quickly brought them to all the people.

public_domain_references.bsb: They roasted the Passover animals on the fire according to the regulation, and they boiled the other holy offerings in pots, kettles, and bowls and quickly brought them to all the people.
public_domain_references.web: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.
public_domain_references.asv: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: and the holy offerings boiled they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the [other] holy [offerings] sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided [them] speedily among all the people.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thus [they did] till the morning. And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance; and boiled the holy [pieces] in copper vessels and caldrons, and [the feast] went on well, and they quickly served all the children of the people.

pob.text: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests[a], because the priests, the sons of Aaron, were occupied in offering up the burnt offering and the fat portions until night. So the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.

spob.text: After that, the Levites prepared food for themselves and for the priests,[a] because the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, were busy offering the burnt offering and the fat portions until night. So the Levites prepared food for themselves and for the priests.

public_domain_references.bsb: Afterward, they made preparations for themselves and for the priests, since the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were offering up burnt offerings and fat until nightfall. So the Levites made preparations for themselves and for the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
public_domain_references.web: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
public_domain_references.asv: And afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron [were busied] in offering the burnt-offerings and the fat until night: therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
public_domain_references.kjv: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron [were busied] in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
public_domain_references.brenton: And after they had prepared for themselves and for the priests, for the priests [were engaged] in offering the whole-burnt-offerings and the fat until night, then the Levites prepared for themselves, and for their brethren the sons of Aaron.

pob.text: And the singers[a], the sons of Asaph, were at their stations according to the command of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at each gate. They had no need to depart from their service[b], because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

spob.text: The singers from Asaph’s family stood in their assigned places, as David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun—the king’s seer—had commanded. The gatekeepers stood at each gate. They did not need to leave their duties,[a] because their brothers among the Levites made preparations for them.

public_domain_references.bsb: The singers, the descendants of Asaph, were at their stations according to the command of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer. And the gatekeepers at each gate did not need to leave their position, because their fellow Levites made preparations for them.

pob.text: So his servants removed him from the chariot and set him on the second chariot that belonged to him[a], and brought him to Jerusalem. And he died and was buried in the tombs of his fathers, and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
