public_domain_references.web: At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of Yahweh’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: And at the return of the year king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of Jehovah, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: And at the turn of the year, king Nabuchodonosor sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the precious vessels of the house of the Lord, and made Sedekias his father's brother king over Juda and Jerusalem.

pob.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

spob.text: Zedekiah became king at the age of twenty-one. He ruled as king in Jerusalem for eleven years.

public_domain_references.bsb: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.
public_domain_references.web: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem:
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Zedekiah [was] one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: Sedekias [was] twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

pob.text: He did what was evil in the eyes of Yahweh his God[a], and he did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke from the mouth of Yahweh.

spob.text: He did what Yahweh his God saw as evil. He refused to humble himself before the prophet Jeremiah, who spoke words that came from the mouth of Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke for the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from Yahweh’s mouth.
public_domain_references.asv: and he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah his God; he humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet [speaking] from the mouth of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he did [that which was] evil in the sight of the LORD his God, [and] humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet [speaking] from the mouth of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord his God: he was not ashamed before the prophet Jeremias, nor because of the word of the Lord;

pob.text: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar[a], who had made him swear by God; he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart from turning to Yahweh[b], the God of Israel.

spob.text: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, even though the king had made him swear an oath by God.[a] He remained stubborn: he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart, refusing to turn to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God. But Zedekiah stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to the LORD, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.web: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning unto Jehovah, the God of Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: in that he rebelled against king Nabuchodonosor, which he adjured him by God [not to do]: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart, so as not to return to the Lord God of Israel.

pob.text: Also all the leaders of the priests and the people increased in unfaithfulness[a], according to all the abominations of the nations, and they defiled the house of Yahweh[b], which he had consecrated in Jerusalem.

spob.text: All the leaders of the priests and the people also committed more and more acts of unfaithfulness toward God. They followed all the detestable practices of the nations and defiled Yahweh’s temple,[a] which he had set apart as holy in Jerusalem.

public_domain_references.bsb: Furthermore, all the leaders of the priests and the people multiplied their unfaithful deeds, following all the abominations of the nations, and they defiled the house of the LORD, which He had consecrated in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.web: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted Yahweh’s house which he had made holy in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.asv: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests, and the people, trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted the house of Jehovah which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
public_domain_references.brenton: And all the great men of Juda, and the priests, and the people of the land transgressed abundantly in the abominations of the heathen, and polluted the house of the Lord which [was] in Jerusalem.

pob.text: And Yahweh[a], the God of their fathers, sent word to them by the hand of his messengers, rising early and sending[c][b], because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place.

spob.text: Yahweh, the God of their ancestors, eagerly sent them message after message through his prophetic messengers, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place among them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Again and again the LORD, the God of their fathers, sent word to His people through His messengers because He had compassion on them and on His dwelling place.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;
public_domain_references.asv: And Jehovah, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling-place:
public_domain_references.kjv: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord God of their fathers sent by the hand of his prophets; rising early and sending his messengers, for he spared his people, and his sanctuary.

pob.text: But they kept mocking the messengers of God[a], despising his words, and scoffing at his prophets, until the wrath of Yahweh rose against his people[b], until there was no remedy.

spob.text: But they kept mocking the messengers God sent. They treated his words with contempt and ridiculed his prophets. This continued until Yahweh’s wrath rose against his people—until there was no remedy.

public_domain_references.bsb: But they mocked the messengers of God, despising His words and scoffing at His prophets, until the wrath of the LORD against His people was stirred up beyond remedy.
public_domain_references.web: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.
public_domain_references.asv: but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until the wrath of Jehovah arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
public_domain_references.kjv: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till [there was] no remedy.
public_domain_references.brenton: Nevertheless they sneered at his messengers, and set at nought his words, and mocked his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord rose up against his people, till there was no remedy.

pob.text: So he brought up against them the king of the Chaldeans[a], who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or aged man[c][b]. He gave all into his hand.

spob.text: So God brought the king of the Chaldeans[a] against them. The king killed their young men with the sword inside their temple. He showed no compassion to young men or young unmarried women[b], to the old or the very old. God handed them all over to the king’s power.

public_domain_references.bsb: So He brought up against them the king of the Chaldeans, who put their young men to the sword in the sanctuary, sparing neither young men nor young women, neither elderly nor infirm. God gave them all into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar,
public_domain_references.web: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or infirm. He gave them all into his hand.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldeans, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or virgin, old man or hoary-headed: he gave them all into his hand.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave [them] all into his hand.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he brought against them the king of the Chaldeans, and slew their young men with the sword in the house of his sanctuary, and did not spare Sedekias, and had no mercy upon their virgins, and they led away their old men: he delivered all things into their hands.

pob.text: And all the vessels of the house of God[a], great and small, and the treasures of the house of Yahweh[b], and the treasures of the king and of his officials—all this he brought to Babylon.

spob.text: He took to Babylon all the objects from God’s temple, large and small. He also took the treasures from Yahweh’s temple and the treasures belonging to the king and his officials. He took everything.

public_domain_references.bsb: who carried off everything to Babylon—all the articles of the house of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king and his officials.
public_domain_references.web: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.
public_domain_references.asv: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.
public_domain_references.kjv: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all [these] he brought to Babylon.
public_domain_references.brenton: And all the vessels of the house of God, the great and the small, and the treasures of the house of the Lord, and all the treasures of the king and the great men; he brought all to Babylon.

pob.text: They burned the house of God[a], tore down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire[b], and destroyed all its precious vessels.

spob.text: They burned down God’s house—the temple—and tore down Jerusalem’s wall. They set all the city’s palaces on fire and destroyed all its precious objects.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the Chaldeans set fire to the house of God and broke down the wall of Jerusalem. They burned down all the palaces and destroyed every article of value.
public_domain_references.web: They burned God’s house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels.
public_domain_references.asv: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt its palaces with fire, and [utterly destroyed] every beautiful vessel.

pob.text: He carried into exile to Babylon the remnant who had escaped the sword[a], and they became slaves to him and to his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia.

spob.text: The king of Babylon took the survivors who had escaped the sword into exile to Babylon. They became slaves[a] to him and his sons until the kingdom of Persia came to power.

public_domain_references.bsb: Those who escaped the sword were carried by Nebuchadnezzar into exile in Babylon, and they became servants to him and his sons until the kingdom of Persia came to power.
public_domain_references.web: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,
public_domain_references.asv: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
public_domain_references.kjv: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
public_domain_references.brenton: And he carried away the remnant to Babylon; and they were servants to him and to his sons until [the establishment of] the kingdom of the Medes.

pob.text: to fulfill the word of Yahweh by the mouth of Yirmeyahu[a], until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. All the days of its desolation it kept Sabbath[d][c][b], to fulfill seventy years.

spob.text: This happened to fulfill the word Yahweh spoke through Yirmeyahu. The land enjoyed its Sabbaths: throughout the time it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath,[a] until seventy years were completed.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the land enjoyed its Sabbath rest all the days of the desolation, until seventy years were completed, in fulfillment of the word of the LORD through Jeremiah.
public_domain_references.web: to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.
public_domain_references.asv: to fulfil the word of Jehovah by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its sabbaths: [for] as long as it lay desolate it kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
public_domain_references.kjv: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: [for] as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
public_domain_references.brenton: That the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremias might be fulfilled, until the land should enjoy its sabbaths in resting [and] sabbath keeping all the days of its desolation, till the accomplishment of seventy years.

pob.text: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia[a], so that the word of Yahweh by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and also in writing, saying:

spob.text: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, Yahweh stirred Cyrus’s spirit so that the word Yahweh had spoken through Jeremiah[a] would be fulfilled. Cyrus issued a proclamation throughout his kingdom and also put it in writing. It said:

public_domain_references.bsb: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah, the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation throughout his kingdom and to put it in writing as follows:
public_domain_references.web: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
public_domain_references.asv: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of Jehovah by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Jehovah stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and [put it] also in writing, saying,
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD [spoken] by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and [put it] also in writing, saying,
public_domain_references.brenton: In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, after the fulfilment of the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremias, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians, and told him to make proclamation in writing throughout all his kingdom, saying,

pob.text: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: Yahweh[a], the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has charged me to build for him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever is among you of all his people, may Yahweh his God be with him[d][c][b], and let him go up.

spob.text: This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: “Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth. He has commanded me to build a house for him[b] in Jerusalem, in Judah. Anyone among you who belongs to his people—may Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem.[a]”

public_domain_references.bsb: “This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah. Whoever among you belongs to His people, may the LORD his God be with him, and may he go up.’”
public_domain_references.web: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up.’”
public_domain_references.asv: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath Jehovah, the God of heaven, given me; and he hath charged me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whosoever there is among you of all his people, Jehovah his God be with him, and let him go up.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which [is] in Judah. Who [is there] among you of all his people? The LORD his God [be] with him, and let him go up.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians to all the kingdoms of the earth, The Lord God of heaven has given me [power], and he has commanded me to build a house to him in Jerusalem, in Judea. Who [is there] of you of all his people? his God shall be with him, and let him go up.
